scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Advanced Armory Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088高階軍械材料^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 你的物品種類太多了。請在減少物品數量後再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 由於您的物品重量過重，無法繼續。請在減輕負重後再試一次。
由於您的物品重量過重，無法繼續。請在減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text: I don't feel confident in talking since you wouldn't understand anything.
scripts.translation: 既然你聽不懂，我也不敢多說了。

scripts.text: Sapha keeps a distance from you even when you try to talk. Looks like he called on Guard Galten. Time to go.
scripts.translation: 薩法即使你想和他說話，他也保持著距離。看來他叫來了衛兵加爾滕。該走了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It is pretty embarassing that you are looking for a request with your level, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
以您的等級尋找請求，這有點尷尬，您知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Calculate your request activities with the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
請前往運營部與^990099補給二部主管^000000計算您的請求活動，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I don't have any requests for you now. Report back to the ^990099Supply Dept. 2 Manager^000000 at Operations after you complete all requests.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
我現在沒有給您的請求。完成所有請求後，請向運營部的^990099補給二部主管^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Welcome.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
歡迎光臨。
您來這裡有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Please explain the request to me.
scripts.translation: 請向我解釋任務。

scripts.text: Please give me a request.
scripts.translation: 請給我一個任務。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Pura will explain the detail about the supply job. I'm soooo busy as you can see.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
普拉會向您解釋補給工作的詳情。如您所見，我忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
I just got a request. It's good that none of us wasted time.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
我剛收到一個請求。幸好我們沒有浪費時間。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It's time to repair the trumpets for Mine supervisors.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
是時候修理米內主管們的號角了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Because those trumpets are necessary to control the miners. The mystic horn from Cornus is the perfect trumpet material, please get 5 pieces of them.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
因為這些號角對於控制礦工來說是必需的。飛馬的魔力之角是完美的號角材料，請獲取5個。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Supervisor's Tool^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088主管的工具^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It seems that there isn't enough amount of fur which is for the adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
似乎用於冒險者的皮毛數量不足。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
It will be necessary to get some fur from Tatacho. 21 lumps will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
需要從噠噠喬身上獲取一些皮毛。21團就足夠了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Preparation for Heating^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088供暖準備^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There was a request from the pub to collect 27 bug legs.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
酒館那邊有一個請求，需要收集27個昆蟲後腳。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They don't wanna reveal the reason why they need them. Anyway, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他們不想透露需要這些的原因。總之，謝謝你了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Suspicious Food^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088可疑的食物^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Zargon is very popular among the residents here. It's a beautiful, round shaped ball and can be used as a adhesive when its powder is mixed with water.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
剎勒空結晶在這裡的居民中很受歡迎。它是一種美麗的圓球，將其粉末與水混合後可用作粘合劑。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Heard that it's very common material from the adventurers' land. Would you get some? It will be enough with 26 Zargons.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
聽說在冒險者的土地上這是一種很常見的材料。能去弄一些嗎？26個剎勒空結晶就足夠了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Useful Material^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088有用的材料^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
有一個請求，需要尋找用於每季度建築修繕工作的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
Please get 13 Solid shells which can be obtained from Centipede and Centipede Larva. It will be very useful for the repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
請從變異蜈蚣和變異蜈蚣幼蟲身上獲取13個堅硬外皮。這對修繕工作非常有用。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088建築必備材料^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
有一個請求，需要尋找用於每季度建築修繕工作的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
You need to get 16 Strong vines which can be got from nepenthes. It's a vital material for building repair work.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
你需要從豬籠草身上獲取16個結實的藤。這是建築修繕工作的關鍵材料。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Essential Material for Construction 2^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088建築必備材料 2^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The guard need many sharp leaves for a decoration reason. Some other adventurers started searching them.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
衛兵們需要很多鋒利的葉子用於裝飾。其他一些冒險者已經開始尋找了。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
They need pretty many quantity of the leaves so they want 26 sharp leaves from you. I know it's hard. Wish you good luck!
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他們需要的葉子數量相當多，所以希望你提供26片鋒利的葉子。我知道這很難。祝你好運！

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Decoration arrangement^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088裝飾佈置^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner is in trouble due to many adventurers from outside.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
由於許多外地冒險者的到來，酒館老闆遇到了麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He wishes to have an utensil which can be used simply and instantly, something like a wide leaf.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他希望能有一種可以簡單、即時使用的器具，比如寬大的葉子。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Instant Receptacle^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088即時容器^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
There have been couple of attacks in mine. It must be those Nepenthes that were trying to attack miners.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
米內發生了幾次襲擊事件。一定是那些試圖攻擊礦工的豬籠草。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
In order to make the medicine, we need 16 brown roots. Find and bring them.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
為了製作藥物，我們需要16個褐色樹根。請找到並帶回來。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Not enough medicine^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088藥物不足^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
The pub owner came by and blamed and blamed about the big appetite of you guys.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
酒館老闆來過，一直抱怨你們胃口太大。

scripts.text:
[Tragis]
He said he has no more stock of honey and fruits. 2 jugs of honey will be enough to soothe him.
scripts.translation:
[特拉吉斯]
他說蜂蜜和水果的存貨都不夠了。兩罐蜂蜜應該就能讓他滿意了。

scripts.text: I got you a request named ^880088Honey robber^000000. You can check details of the request and who to report back to by opening the ^990099Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation: 我為你準備了一個名為^880088蜂蜜大盜^000000的請求。你可以開啟^990099任務視窗^000000檢視請求詳情以及彙報物件。

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Doha]
What is it?
You don't look like you have any business with me.
If you don't, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
什麼事？
你看起來並不像有公事要找我。
如果沒有，請現在離開。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Who is asking?
If you are in the wrong room, please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
誰在問？
如果你走錯房間了，請現在離開。

scripts.text: Came to meet the inspector.
scripts.translation: 來見檢查員

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Me?
Are you the person the captain was speaking of?
What was the name...
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我？
你是船長提到的那個人嗎？
名字是...
{0}？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm.. I don't know why you were chosen but I guess they trusted you enough.
I heard you were chosen to visit El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯...我不知道為什麼選中了你，但我想他們足夠信任你。
我聽說你被選中去拜訪薩法的首都——埃爾·迪卡特斯。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I have a secret mission for you regarding this visit.
More like an order.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
關於這次拜訪，我有一個秘密任務交給你。
與其說是任務，不如說是命令。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I'm the inspector dispatched from the home country because of the report case.
We are working on investigating the truth behind the reported case.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我是因為報告案件而從本國派遣來的檢查員。
我們正在調查報告案件背後的真相。

scripts.text: Report case?
scripts.translation: 報告案件？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
You haven't heard of it?
I thought you already knew..
So you're not the one that collected the report back then?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
你還沒聽說過？
我以為你已經知道了...
所以，當時收集報告的人不是你？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
When the expedition was dispatched before
there was a general report on our research results on various categories
and the messenger that was carrying this report back to home country was attacked.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
之前派遣探險隊時，
有一份關於各類研究結果的總報告，
而攜帶這份報告回國的信使遭到了襲擊。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Luckily the report wasn't stolen completely
and we did get the report after painstakingly restoring it.
The important thing is who did this.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
幸運的是，報告並沒有被完全偷走，
我們費了很大勁才將其修復。
重要的是，是誰做的這件事。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
As you already know the expedition here is an alliance of 3 countries.
And we aren't all in good terms.
That is why Hibba Agip was put in charge by the captain and upper management because he isn't attached to any of the countries.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
如你所知，這裡的探險隊是三個國家的聯盟。
而且我們之間並不和睦。
正因如此，船長和高層才讓希巴·阿吉普負責，因為他不隸屬於任何一個國家。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But the important thing is which country was behind this
and why would they do such a thing when we must promote peace and cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
但重要的是，是哪個國家在幕後指使，
以及在我們必須促進和平與合作的時候，他們為什麼要這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
That is why I was dispatched here to investigate on.
I've come across an unexpected information during my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
所以我被派遣到這裡進行調查。
在調查過程中，我意外地獲得了一條資訊。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Do you know the Cat Merchant?
They are also doing business nearby.
One of the Cat Merchants
spilled this information to me.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
你知道貓商人嗎？
他們也在附近做生意。
其中一隻貓商人
向我透露了這條資訊。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I was investigating at the location assumed to be where the attack took place
when I met a cat. Well.. I don't know what else I'm supposed to call them.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我原本在推測襲擊發生地點進行調查，
結果遇到了一隻貓。嗯...我不知道該叫它什麼。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
But it turns out, I was lucky to meet this cat.
Because he turned out to be a witness to the case.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
但事實證明，我很幸運遇到了這隻貓。
因為它竟然是這起案件的目擊者。

scripts.text: Witness!
scripts.translation: 目擊者！

scripts.text: Who did it?
scripts.translation: 是誰幹的？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Sigh...
He did witness the case but the description I got was...
suspicious at first.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
唉...
他確實目擊了案件，但我得到的描述...
起初聽起來很可疑。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Well... the cat said in his own words.
he might be one of us because he was very agile and quick.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯...那隻貓用他自己的話說，
他可能也是“我們”中的一員，因為他非常敏捷迅速。

scripts.text: Same race? Cat?
scripts.translation: 同族？貓？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes.
I heard the cat say that with my own ears.
He said he went back to the place to see if it was a lost friend of his.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
是的。
我親耳聽到那隻貓這麼說的。
他說他回到那個地方，想看看是不是他走散的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Hmm... my throat is soar from talking too much.
Let's continue later after I get some rest.
I think I need a cup of water.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
嗯...我說話說太多，嗓子都啞了。
讓我休息一下再繼續吧。
我想我需要一杯水。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Thank you.
I'm a little tired now.
I hope to see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
謝謝。
我現在有點累了。
希望下次還能見到你。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Wow.... they say this is the water melted from the snow from the snowy fields.
Very refreshing, don't you agree?
....
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
哇...聽說這是雪原上的雪融化而成的水。
非常清爽，你覺得呢？
...

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Then back to the story.
So I asked why the cat thought it was his own kind.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
那麼回到正題。
我問那隻貓為什麼覺得那是他的同類。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
He said the attacker had a wonderful tail and attractive ears.
Hard to believe.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
他說襲擊者有一條漂亮的尾巴和迷人的耳朵。
難以置信。

scripts.text: It was a cat?
scripts.translation: 是隻貓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
No. I asked the same question.
And he said the attacker looked more like me.
Meaning humanlike to be precise.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
不。我問了同樣的問題。
他說襲擊者看起來更像我。
也就是說，更像人類。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Yes. A human male.
He said ^4d4dff the attacker had attractive ears and a sleek and glossary tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
是的。一個人類男性。
他說^4d4dff襲擊者有迷人的耳朵，還有一條光滑油亮的尾巴^000000！

scripts.text: Could it be a hobby?
scripts.translation: 難道是愛好？

scripts.text:
[Doha]
Are you talking about the Kitty Band that was popular in Prontera?
If a full grown male was wearing one of those... and also a tail?
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
你說的是在普隆德拉很流行的貓耳髮圈嗎？
如果一個成年男性戴著那個...還有一條尾巴？

scripts.text: Was he in disguise?
scripts.translation: 他在偽裝嗎？

scripts.text: Taste should be respected.
scripts.translation: 品味應該被尊重。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I agree.
I think one of the countries is behind this.
I honestly think both the Sapha and Rapine won't get anything out of this.
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我同意。
我認為某個國家在幕後指使。
我真心認為薩法和拉派恩都不會從中獲益。

scripts.text:
[Doha]
I guess it will only be a way of hiding you are from.
Disguised as a cat, that is!
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
我想那只是用來隱藏你的身份。
偽裝成貓，就是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Doha]
....................
............Of course
different tastes should be respected.

[Doha]
....Ahem.
My conclusion is
Someone disguised themselves ridiculously in order to hide where they came from!
scripts.translation:
[道哈]
....咳。
我的結論是，

因為很難見到那位大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The crack here must have been created when the crack in Morocc appeared.
If he did it.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
這裡的裂縫應該是在莫洛克的裂縫出現時產生的。
如果是他造成的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll find a crack northeast from El Dicastes.
Try investigating there.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你會在埃爾·迪卡特斯東北方發現一道裂縫。
試著在那裡調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Any luck?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
有進展嗎？

scripts.text: - You show the {0} you collected from near the crack.-
scripts.translation: - 你展示了從裂縫附近收集的 {0}。 -

scripts.text:
- You do not have the item needed for the quest. Case3
If your quest item was destroyed, request help from GM.-
scripts.translation:
- 你沒有任務所需的物品。Case3
如果你的任務物品被銷燬，請向GM尋求幫助。 -

scripts.text:
[Shay]
.. I didn't expect this.
Then who is Ahat..?
...I smell something fishy.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
...我沒想到會是這樣。
那麼阿哈特到底是誰？
...總覺得哪裡不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't know since I haven't seen Ahat in person but
we must find out what all this means.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
我還沒見過阿哈特本人，所以不清楚。
但我們必須弄清楚這一切到底意味著什麼。

scripts.text: Do you trust BK?
scripts.translation: 你信任BK嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
At least BK doesn't lie.
The BK I know never lies.
Why are these found near the crack?
Why was Ahat near the crack..
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
至少BK不會撒謊。
我認識的BK從不說謊。
為什麼這些東西會在裂縫附近被發現？
為什麼阿哈特會在裂縫附近...

scripts.text: Do you want to meet in person?
scripts.translation: 你想和他見面嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can't just waltz in him.
It's even harder for outsiders like us to meet him.
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你不能就這麼直接闖進去。
對我們這些外人來說，想見他更難了。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
We can try collected exploit certifications.
Those who did great deeds get the opportunity to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
我們可以嘗試收集功勳證明。
立下大功的人才有機會面見大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
The Cat Merchants are also collected exploit certifications. They want to meet the minister in person so they can negotiate business.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
貓商人也是收集功勳證明。他們想面見大臣，以便洽談生意。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You can receive exploit certifications from handling requests throughout the city.
If you want to meet the minister Ahat...
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你可以在城裡處理委託來獲得功勳證明。
如果你想面見大臣阿哈特...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You'll need at least ^4d4dff3 exploit certifications^000000.
Go ^4d4dffask around in Diel^000000 for more information.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你至少需要^4d4dff3個功勳證明^000000。
去^4d4dff迪爾^000000四處打聽一下更多資訊吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha that registers adventurers in Diel.
Was his name ^4d4dffRhawyne^000000. Ask him.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
在迪爾登記冒險者的薩法。
他的名字是^4d4dff拉溫^000000。去問問他。

scripts.text: Don't you have any exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 你沒有薩法的功勳證明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
................
Do you think I'm that free?
I'm not the one receiving request, I'm the one that makes the requests!!
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
................
你以為我那麼大方嗎？
我是釋出委託的人，不是接委託的人！！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.
First, think of what you have to do.
Meet Ahat by collecting exploit certifications.
And then find doubt what is the relationship between him and the crack.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
嘖。
首先，想想你要做什麼。
收集功勳證明，然後面見阿哈特。
之後查明他和裂縫之間的關係。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Start with collecting exploit certifications.
You'll need at least 3 certifications to meet the minister.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
先從收集功勳證明開始吧。
你需要至少3個證明才能面見大臣。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Once you have your certifications, go make a request to meet the minister at the Adventurer's reception desk in Diel.
Rhawyne will help you.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
拿到證明後，去迪爾的冒險者接待處申請面見大臣。
拉溫會幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So.. you got permitted?
I'm also curious who this Ahat character is.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
那麼...你獲得許可了？
我也很好奇阿哈特到底是個什麼樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Good. I'll prepare some food until you come back.
I just found this amazing chocolate recipe a few days ago.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
很好。在你回來之前，我會準備一些食物。
幾天前我剛發現了一個很棒的巧克力食譜。

scripts.text: Oh..no..

[Shay]
When I was in Morocc.
A colleague from the guild used to make chocolate stuff you see?
I thought it would be simple since he was making it.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
當我在莫洛克的時候。
公會裡的一個同事經常做巧克力之類的東西，你懂吧？
我覺得既然他能做，應該很簡單。
那麼...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Wait till you taste it.
Now, get going.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
等你嘗過就知道了。
現在，快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How was the minister?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
大臣怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Strange.
scripts.translation: 奇怪。

scripts.text: ..Beautiful...

[Shay]
So.. how strange.
..was it bad or good?
No, that isn't important. Try to remember what you were there for.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
所以...很奇怪。
...是壞還是好？
不，這不重要。試著回憶一下你當時在那裡是為了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Really?
You can tell the beauty even if the race is different.
Do you job instead of dreaming about his appearance.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
哈？真的嗎？
即使種族不同，也能看出他的美嗎。
別做夢了，去做好你的工作吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm...
Clearing the crack area?
Sounds weird.
Something smells fishy.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
嗯...
清理裂縫區域？
聽起來很怪。
總覺得有些蹊蹺。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Don't forget to bring back evidence.
And to pretend you are hypnotized.
Good. This is our secret.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
別忘了帶證據回來。
還有，假裝自己被催眠了。
很好。這是我們的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Funny how things come about.
But you really are talkative.
You are telling me everything. Tsk.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
世事真是奇妙。
不過你還真能說。
什麼都告訴我了。嘖。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Did you know?
There is another skillful Jarute.
Name is HesLanta.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你知道嗎？
還有另一個技藝高超的賈魯特。
名字是赫斯蘭塔。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
He sometimes come back and shares his stories.
But I think he also has a story to tell.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
他有時會回來分享他的故事。
但我覺得他也有故事要講。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
It's only a thought but
It might be good to talk to those near Ahat too.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
這只是個想法，
但也許跟阿哈特身邊的人聊聊也不錯。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How about talking to the Jarute named HesLanta?
You don't have nothing to lose, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
跟那個叫赫斯蘭塔的賈魯特聊聊怎麼樣？
反正你也輸不起什麼。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why are you here again?
Are you working?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你怎麼又來了？
是在工作嗎？

scripts.text: Mission completed!
scripts.translation: 任務完成！

scripts.text: Came to thank you.
scripts.translation: 來感謝你的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Really?
Good for you.
.....
Mission. Haven't heard that word for ages.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
真的嗎？
真不錯。
.....
任務。好久沒聽到這個詞了。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Now go.
I'm busy.
New ingredients are coming in today.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
現在走吧。
我很忙。
今天有新食材要進。
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
If you are that grateful, each all my new cuisines till the last bite.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
如果你這麼感激的話，就把我新做的菜吃到最後一口吧。

scripts.text: Ah, that is um...
scripts.translation: 啊，那個是...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Huh? Get lost.
Ungrateful....
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
哈？滾開。
真沒良心...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你想幹什麼？

scripts.text: Tell me about yourself
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於你的事

scripts.text: About Sapha
scripts.translation: 關於薩法

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Me?
Didn't I tell you before?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
我？
我之前沒告訴過你嗎？

scripts.text: Nope..
scripts.translation: 沒有...

scripts.text:
[Shay]
No, I told you my story before.
But since you have bad memory, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
不，我之前講過我的故事。
不過既然你記性不好，我就再講一遍。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Hmm. Then should I tell you the story on how I settled here?
The first to apply to expedite here
where the Assassins.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
嗯。那我要不要告訴你我是怎麼定居在這裡的？
最早申請在這裡建立前哨站的是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I was one of them.
That is how I got to reach this place before anyone else did
And that is how the base of the expedition camp was built.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
我就是其中之一。
所以我比任何人都先到達了這個地方，
前哨站基地也是由此建成的。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
But you know.
I thought I'd return to my hometown and retire.
But El Dicastes contacted me.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
但你知道的。
我本想回到家鄉退休。
但El Dicastes聯絡了我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
They requested if I could open a place for us outsides to feel comfortable with.
They also were considerate enough to build it in Midgard style.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
他們請求我能否為我們在外面的人提供一個舒適的地方。
他們甚至體貼地要求按米德加爾特風格建造。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
So the framework and style,
architect was brought in..
and then I found myself managing the whole project?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
於是框架和風格，
建築師被請來了..
然後我發現自己竟然在管理整個專案？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
And...
that is how I got here.
I've been here ever since!
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
然後...
我就來到了這裡。
從那以後我就一直待在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I don't remember what my original job was.
Little rusty on the Katar, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
我不記得我原來的職業是什麼了。
拳刃用得有點生疏了，我想...

scripts.text:
Shay suddenly has a lonely expression and sighs deeply about his situation.
Looks very tired.
scripts.translation:
謝伊突然露出寂寞的神情，為他的處境深深嘆息。
看起來非常疲憊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Sapha?
You are surrounded by Saphas.
......
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
薩法？
你周圍全是薩法。
......

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What are you asking me?
Just ask any Sapha passing by.
Ask 'what are you'.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你問我什麼？
隨便問一個路過的薩法。
問問“你們是什麼”。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What...
I'm not that busy but don't bother me too much.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
什麼...
我不算太忙，但別太煩我。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
What did you bring here now?
.........
What? No?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你現在帶了什麼來？
.........
什麼？沒有？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Tsk.... boring.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
嘖...真無聊。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Why is strawberry chocolate so difficult to make?
Why is my chocolate falling apart?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
為什麼草莓巧克力這麼難做？
為什麼我的巧克力總是散架？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Also this chocolate pie.
How do I bake it just the right golden color?
Why can't it be white or black?
It isn't the pie that is important. It's the chocolate that is.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
還有這個巧克力派。
怎麼才能烤出恰到好處的金黃色？
為什麼不能是白色或者黑色？
重要的不是派，而是巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
How did my colleague make this?!
............
...Do girls like this?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
我的同事是怎麼做出這個的？！
............
...女孩們喜歡這個嗎？

scripts.text: They normally do like homemade chocolate.
scripts.translation: 她們通常喜歡自制的巧克力。

scripts.text: No. only aliens.
scripts.translation: 不，只有外星人喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
I see.
So...
Are you married?
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
原來如此。
那麼...
你結婚了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shay]
You're alone, right?
....
Sorry.
We're in the same boat.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
你是單身，對吧？
....
抱歉。
我們處境相同。

scripts.text:
[Shay]
Suit yourself.
scripts.translation:
[謝伊]
隨你便吧。

[尼特]
（亂碼）

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 無法與他交流。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Welcome, human.
I'm finally used to meeting other races like you.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
歡迎，人類。
我終於習慣見到你們這樣的其他種族了。

scripts.text: Are there races other than humans?
scripts.translation: 除了人類還有其他種族嗎？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
There were Rapine before you came.
And of course there are still.
But they are over the Kamidal mountains.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
在你來之前有拉皮涅。
當然現在也有。
不過它們在卡米達爾山脈那邊。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And then the cats..
Ah, did you see the group of cats in front of the castle?
They are really soft and cuddly unlike us.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
還有貓...
啊，你看到城堡前面那群貓了嗎？
它們真的非常柔軟可愛，不像我們。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
And especially their ear and tail!!
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
尤其是它們的耳朵和尾巴！！

scripts.text: Have you seen this man?
scripts.translation: 你見過這個男子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Eh? Huh?
Man? Human male?
A human male with cat ears?
Never heard such thing..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
誒？什麼？
男子？人類男性？
長著貓耳朵的人類男性？
從來沒聽說過這種事...

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Humans are amazing!
Didn't even think of that...!
.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
人類真不可思議！
我甚至都沒想過...！
.....

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But they are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但它們真的很可愛。
那些可愛的貓...

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但阿哈特即使是薩法也很可愛。
....如果我的頭髮像冬天的枯樹...
阿哈特的頭髮就像早春的新芽.....

scripts.text:
[Knit]
I can't believe how he does his work for Dicastes
and still maintain such great hair.
I can almost see a glow.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
真不敢相信他能為迪卡斯特工作
還能保持如此完美的頭髮。
我幾乎能看到他在發光。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.....his skin is divine.
But he never comes out from his office high up in Dicastes Diel.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊.....他的皮膚是神聖的。
但他從不離開迪卡斯特迪爾高處的辦公室。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But I guess it would be better for Ahat's complexion...
to stay warm and safe like a crystal bird in Diel instead of being out in the winter weather!
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但我想，對阿哈特的膚色來說...
像迪爾裡的水晶鳥一樣待在溫暖安全的地方，而不是在冬天的天氣裡，會更好！

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 繼續談論阿哈特。
我想我得不到更多情報了。 -

scripts.text:
[Knit]
They are really lovely.
Those cute cats..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
它們真的很可愛。
那些可愛的貓...

scripts.text:
[Knit]
But Ahat is also loveable even for a Sapha.
....if my hair is like a dry winter tree..
Ahat's hair is like new sprouts in early spring.....
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
但阿哈特即使是薩法也很可愛。
....如果我的頭髮像冬天的枯樹...
阿哈特的頭髮就像早春的新芽.....

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Ah.. I'm so jealous, envious..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
啊..我好嫉妒，好羨慕..

scripts.text:
[Knit]
As you can see, I'm taking a walk.
I should walk from time to time to prevent myself from getting stiff.
I really don't like to get stiff.
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
如你所見，我在散步。
我應該時不時走走，防止自己變得僵硬。
我真的不喜歡變得僵硬。

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Don't you think cats are amazing.
I heard from where you came from, you have pets..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
你不覺得貓很不可思議嗎。
我聽說你來自的地方，你們有寵物..

scripts.text:
[Knit]
Is it okay to raise other creatures?
Do they want that?
It's a difficult issue..
scripts.translation:
[尼特]
飼養其他生物是可以的嗎？
它們願意嗎？
這是個棘手的問題..

[皮奧姆]
...？
啊~！
你...你是人類嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Piom]
[Piom]
Phew.. I need to rest.
Huh? You're... human!
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
呼..我需要休息一下。
誒？你是...人類！
你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Piom]
[Piom]
As you can see, I'm taking a rest.
I like my job but it is so tiresome.
But I'm happier than when I was a Knit.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
如你所見，我在休息。
我喜歡我的工作，但它太累了。
但我比當尼特的時候更快樂。

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 無法與他交流。

scripts.text: About a human with cat ears..
scripts.translation: 關於長著貓耳朵的人類..

scripts.text:
[Piom]
HAHAHAHA!!!
HAHAHAHA!!!
There are so many asking about that recently.
Is there any conflict with the Cat Merchants?
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
哈哈哈哈！！
哈哈哈哈！！
最近問這個問題的人可真多。
難道你和貓商人之間有什麼衝突嗎？

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Haha.. ... funny.
Human with cat ears. Never heard of such thing.
But you seem to be new around here.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
哈哈... ...真有趣。
長著貓耳朵的人類？我從沒聽說過這種事。
不過你看起來像是剛到這裡的新人。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Don't waste your time on something ridiculous as that
That's it! I think you are the right person.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
別在這種荒唐的事情上浪費時間了。
好了！我覺得你就是我要找的人。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
The minister stays at the top of Diel
Try meeting the minister.
He is a wonderful person.
A role model to all Saphas!
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
大臣住在迪爾（Diel）的頂端。
去見見大臣吧。
他是個非常好的人。
是所有薩法（Sapha）的榜樣！

scripts.text:
[Piom]
You need to know about Saphas if you are staying in El Dicastes, right?
Don't spend time with a dusty Piom like me, and go meet Ahat.
You will love him.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
如果你要留在埃爾·迪卡特斯（El Dicastes），就需要了解薩法，對吧？
別在我這個滿身灰塵的皮奧姆身上浪費時間了，去見見阿哈特吧。
你會喜歡他的。

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 繼續談論阿哈特。
我想我得不到更多情報了。 -

scripts.text:
[Piom]
Don't follow cats around
Go and meet Ahat.
He is really beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
別跟著貓跑了。
去見見阿哈特吧。
他真的很美。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
I can't think straight.
I didn't like working through documents the Knits do.
But then Galtens have to carry heavy weapons.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
我腦子有點亂。
我不喜歡處理尼特（Knit）們做的那些文書工作。
但加爾滕（Galten）又得搬運沉重的武器。

scripts.text:
[Piom]
The last thing I did was mine and refine Bradium
and I loved it!
And to think that my work keeps everyone healthy
is rewarding.
scripts.translation:
[皮奧姆]
我最後做的工作是挖掘和精煉魔力之石，
我非常喜歡！
想到我的工作能讓大家保持健康，
這就很有意義了。

scripts.text: Cannot communicate with him.
scripts.translation: 無法與他交流。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Hmm...another peaceful day.
Hmm? Aren't you the outsider that came here awhile ago?
Have you come to see the training grounds?
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
嗯...又是平靜的一天。
嗯？你難道就是之前來過這裡的外鄉人嗎？
你是來看訓練場的嗎？

scripts.text: About a human with cat ears..
scripts.translation: 關於長著貓耳朵的人類..

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Cat ears?
Is there someone like that?
Humans are like that?
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
貓耳朵？
有這樣的人嗎？
人類都是那樣的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Galten]
What? No?
Then why are you looking him..
Why don't you go meet Ahat instead of wasting your time.
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
什麼？沒有？
那你為什麼一直盯著他看...
別浪費時間了，去見見阿哈特吧。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Anyone that wants to be strong
should meet Ahat.
He is a very strong Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
任何想要變強的人
都應該去見見阿哈特。
他是非常強大的薩法。

scripts.text:
[Galten]
He may be a Jarute working through piles of documents
but he must be hiding his power!
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
他可能只是個處理堆積如山的文書的賈魯特（Jarute），
但他一定隱藏著實力！

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Everyone says Ahat is like a delicate spring sprout
but I don't agree!
I've never seen a stronger Sapha before.
But I don't quite understand why he didn't become a Galten...
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
大家都說阿哈特像嬌嫩的春芽，
但我不同意！
我從未見過比他更強的薩法。
但我不太明白他為什麼沒有成為加爾滕...

scripts.text:
- Continues to talk about Ahat.
Don't think I'll get any more information. -
scripts.translation:
- 繼續談論阿哈特。
我想我得不到更多情報了。 -

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Ahat...
He is a strong Sapha.
He may be a minister working through piles of documents
but he must be hiding his power!
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
阿哈特...
他是強大的薩法。
他可能只是個處理堆積如山的文書的大臣，
但他一定隱藏著實力！

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Everyone says Ahat is like a delicate spring sprout
but I don't agree!
I've never seen a stronger Sapha before.
But I don't quite understand why he didn't become a Galten...
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
大家都說阿哈特像嬌嫩的春芽，
但我不同意！
我從未見過比他更強的薩法。
但我不太明白他為什麼沒有成為加爾滕...

scripts.text:
[Galten]
Maybe he is physically strong but has a warm heart..
but you never know...
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
也許他身體很強壯，但內心很溫柔..
但誰知道呢...

scripts.text:
[Galten]
You seem to be an experienced adventurer.
I would like to try you out
.. Hahahah
Just joking. I cannot fight a guest to our land.
scripts.translation:
[加爾滕]
你看起來是個經驗豐富的冒險者。
我想試試你的身手
... 哈哈哈哈哈
開玩笑的。我不能攻擊我們土地上的客人。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ha. I'm the information collector of the Cat Merchants.
Ask me anything...but..
Meow.. I'm not an easy cat you see.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈。我是貓商人的情報收集者。
儘管問吧...但是..
喵..我可不是好惹的貓哦。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Go away, Ha
scripts.translation:
[BK]
走開，哈

scripts.text:
[BK]
Hmph...
What is it?
... Oh, a human in the capital city of Sapha.
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哼...
什麼事？
...哦，薩法首都城裡的人類。
喵...

scripts.text: About a man with cat ears
scripts.translation: 關於長貓耳的男子

scripts.text: What are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ha, I'm BK. The Cat Merchants' infamous information collector.
But I have no information to share with you.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈，我是BK。貓商團裡臭名昭著的情報收集者。
但我沒有情報可以分享給你。

scripts.text:
[BK]
I'm not an easy cat you see.
Meow... meow
Meow.. cat ears. Hahaha.. I heard of some.. meow..
scripts.translation:
[BK]
我可不是好惹的貓哦。
喵...喵
喵..貓耳。哈哈哈..我聽說過一些..喵..

scripts.text:
[BK]
I'm not telling you~!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
我才不告訴你呢~!

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ha. I'm the information collector of the Cat Merchants.
Ask me anything...but..
Meow.. I'm not an easy cat you see.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈。我是貓商人的情報收集者。
儘管問吧...但是..
喵..我可不是好惹的貓哦。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ha. I'm the information collector of the Cat Merchants.
..............
I don't give out information just to anyone.
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈。我是貓商團的情報收集者。
..............
我不會隨便把情報告訴任何人。
喵...

scripts.text:
- BK of the Cat Merchant group is being difficult.
What did Shay tell you to do?-
scripts.translation:
- 貓商團的BK態度很不好。
謝伊讓你做什麼了？-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm. If you don't cooperate,
Shay's special drink will be delivered.
By Shay himself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。如果你不配合，
謝伊的特製飲料就會送過來。
由謝伊親自送來！

scripts.text:
[BK]
What?!
What do you want.
Why are you harassing me.
Bully... sob
scripts.translation:
[BK]
什麼？！
你想怎樣。
為什麼要糾纏我。
惡霸...嗚嗚

scripts.text:
[BK]
Okay. I will cooperate.
But with some conditions.
First, you must tell Shay that I cooperated with you.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
好吧。我會配合。
但有些條件。
首先，你必須告訴謝伊我配合了你。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Second, we must meet the minister to expand our business.
But need exploit certifications to meet him.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
其次，我們要見大臣以拓展業務。
但需要開拓許可證才能見他。

scripts.text:
[BK]
So I'll sell my information for exploit certifications.
Tell me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
所以我會用情報換取開拓許可證。
準備好了告訴我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1}.....?
Hmm.. I think you are wrong?
What was it..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
{1}.....?
嗯..我覺得你搞錯了？
那是..什麼來著..

scripts.text:
[BK]
What. Are you threatening me with that?
Meow.. You don't know my well enough~!!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
什麼。你拿那個威脅我？
喵..你還不瞭解我~!!

scripts.text:
[BK]
... So what do you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
...那你想問什麼？

scripts.text: About other feline races
scripts.translation: 關於其他貓科種族

scripts.text:
[BK]
Feline? Are you asking about us cats?
Well~
Don't know about races..but.. hahah..
scripts.translation:
[BK]
貓科？你是問我們貓嗎？
嗯~
關於種族的事..我不太清楚..哈哈哈..

scripts.text: - BK asks for an exploit certification. -
scripts.translation: - BK索要一張開拓許可證。-

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Give.
scripts.translation: 給

scripts.text:
[BK]
Humph
We made a deal.
Give an Exploit certification of Sapha to BK.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哼
我們達成交易了。
給BK一張薩法的開拓許可證。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Haha.. good, good.
I don't know anything outside of our race
but I did see ^4d4dffsomeone with cute ears that has been visiting the Dicastes Diel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
哈哈...好，很好。
我對外面的世界一無所知，
但我確實見過^4d4dff一個長著可愛耳朵的人，他經常來迪爾城^000000。

scripts.text:
[BK]
I even saw him meet the ^4d4dffnew minister^000000 alone.
Hu hu...
Satisfied?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
我還看到他單獨會見了^4d4dff新上任的大臣^000000。
呼呼...
滿意了嗎？

scripts.text:
- BK says this and takes the exploit certification out of your hand.
Information on the person with animal ears Doha mentioned!-
scripts.translation:
- BK說著，從你手中拿走了開拓許可證。
道哈提到的那個長著動物耳朵的人的情報！-

scripts.text:
[BK]
I will give you information
and you give me an exploit certification
great teamwork, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
我給你情報，
你給我開拓許可證，
真是完美的合作，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[BK]
If you want to know my information, you have to give me an exploit certification.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
如果你想了解我的情報，就得給我開拓許可證。

scripts.text:
[BK]
...Didn't I just tell you about the man with cat ears?
I've seen him with the minister in Diel.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
...我剛才不是告訴你那個長貓耳的男人了嗎？
我在迪爾城看到他和大臣在一起。

scripts.text: About Ravail?
scripts.translation: 關於拉維爾？

scripts.text: Who is the minister?
scripts.translation: 大臣是誰？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ravail is the high minister.
Something like a Chief.
They also call him elder.
We would call him leader?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
拉維爾是大臣。
有點像首領。
他們也叫他長老。
我們要叫他首領嗎？

scripts.text:
[BK]
.......ah.........
I should have gotten an exploit certification before answering.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
.......啊........
我應該在回答之前先拿到開拓許可證。

scripts.text:
[BK]
The infamous
^4d4dffAhat^000000.
The new minister...
(BK rubs his front paws together)
scripts.translation:
[BK]
臭名昭著的
^4d4dff阿哈特^000000。
新上任的大臣...
(BK搓了搓前爪)

scripts.text: Give a certification.
scripts.translation: 給許可證

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text:
[BK]
No, no, contract violation.
I have nothing to say if you don't give me a certification.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
不不，這是違約。
如果你不給我許可證，我無話可說。

scripts.text:
[BK]
I have nothing to say if you don't give me a certification.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
如果你不給我許可證，我無話可說。

scripts.text:
[BK]
The new minister is not from around here.
There is a huge crack down there.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
新上任的大臣不是本地人。
下面有一道巨大的裂縫。

scripts.text:
[BK]
The new minister was picked up ^4d4dffnear the crack^000000.
He must be an alien!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
新上任的大臣是在^4d4dff裂縫附近^000000被發現的。
他一定是外星人！

scripts.text: What do you think so?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼這麼想？

scripts.text:
[BK]
What is it now?
Another minister story?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
現在又怎麼了？
又是大臣的故事？

scripts.text: That the minister is an alien?
scripts.translation: 大臣是外星人？

scripts.text: Nothing...
scripts.translation: 什麼也沒找到...

scripts.text:
[BK]
MEOW~
I thought you brought Shay's food here as a reward.
(BK shivers at the thought)
scripts.translation:
[BK]
喵~
我還以為你帶了謝伊的食物來作為獎勵。
(BK一想到就發抖)

scripts.text:
[BK]
Eeeew...
I can't even imagine it.
...........Ha! Don't tell Shay this!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
呸...
我簡直無法想像。
...........哈！千萬別告訴謝伊！

scripts.text:
[BK]
Because he isn't Sapha!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
因為他不是薩法！

scripts.text: He isn't a Sapha?
scripts.translation: 他不是薩法？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Yes.
But isn't it strange.
All the Saphas here think he is a beautiful Sapha...
But I've seen him from a distance and he wasn't.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
是的。
但這不是很奇怪嗎？
這裡的薩法們都覺得他是個漂亮的薩法...
但我遠遠看過他，他並不是。

scripts.text:
[BK]
To me, he is a feline.
He might even be a lost friend of mine.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
對我來說，他是一隻貓科動物。
他可能甚至是我走散的朋友。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Well, I don't understand why because all Saphas
are beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
嗯，我不明白為什麼，因為所有薩法都很漂亮。

scripts.text:
- BK says this and takes the exploit certification out of your hand.
Shocking information that the Sapha minister Ahat is not a Sapha!-
scripts.translation:
- BK說完這句話，從你手中拿走了探索證明。
令人震驚的訊息：大臣阿哈特並不是薩法！-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I must find out.
.. Near the crack he said...
Should I talk to Shay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我必須查清楚。
.. 他說的裂縫附近...
我應該去問問謝伊嗎？

scripts.text:
- BK holds up a front paw at my question.
The pink jelly like paws are asking for an exploit certification.-
scripts.translation:
- BK抬起前爪示意我。
那粉紅色的果凍般的爪子似乎在索要探索證明。-

scripts.text:
[BK]
Why are you always coming back?
Why don't you go to the crack yourself if you are curious about the new minister?
You'll find something there since he was from there. Meow
scripts.translation:
[BK]
你為什麼總是回來？
如果你對新大臣好奇，為什麼不自己去裂縫看看？
既然他來自那裡，你在那裡會發現些什麼的。喵

scripts.text:
[BK]
MEOW~
I thought you brought Shay's food here as a reward.
(BK shivers at the thought)
scripts.translation:
[BK]
喵~
我還以為你帶了謝伊的食物來作為獎勵。
(BK一想到就發抖)

scripts.text:
[BK]
Eeeew...
I can't even imagine it.
...........Ha! Don't tell Shay this!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
呸...
我簡直無法想像。
...........哈！千萬別告訴謝伊！

scripts.text: - You can too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
There are many piles of rock around because of the unstable crustal movements.
This rock pile is also one of them.
Don't see anything suspicious.
scripts.translation:
由於地殼運動不穩定，周圍有許多岩石堆。
這個岩石堆也是其中之一。
沒有發現任何可疑的東西。

scripts.text:
There a several dirt piles nearby the crack.
This is one of them.
Don't see anything suspicious.
scripts.translation:
裂縫附近有幾個土堆。
這是其中之一。
沒有發現任何可疑的東西。

scripts.text:
Surface of the earth is split by the shock from the dimensional crack.
The split earth is solid and icy making it look like sharp blades.
Don't see anything suspicious.
scripts.translation:
地表被次元裂縫的衝擊震裂。
裂開的地面堅硬且冰冷，看起來像鋒利的刀刃。
沒有發現任何可疑的東西。

scripts.text: Don't see anything suspicious.
scripts.translation: 沒有發現任何可疑的東西。

scripts.text: Knock down the pebbles that make up the pile of rocks and spread them out.
scripts.translation: 打散構成岩石堆的碎石，將它們鋪開。

scripts.text: You step on the dug up dirt pile and make the ground flat.
scripts.translation: 你踩在挖開的土堆上，將地面踩平。

scripts.text: You step on the dry, split surface and make the ground flat.
scripts.translation: 你踩在乾燥開裂的地面上，將地面踩平。

scripts.text:
You feel an evil energy from the small stone fragments.
Doesn't look natural but more like remnants from a powerful magic spell nearby.
You feel evil energy. Does this have anything to do with Ahat?
You collected a stone that emits strange energy.
scripts.translation:
你感覺到從小石塊中散發出的邪惡能量。
看起來不自然，更像是附近強大魔法法術的殘留物。
你感覺到邪惡能量。這與阿哈特有關嗎？
你收集了一塊散發奇怪能量的石塊。

scripts.text:
You poke around the dirt pile to find blood clotted in the dirt.
You feel evil energy. Does this have anything to do with Ahat?
You collect the clotted bloodstains.
scripts.translation:
你在土堆裡翻找，發現泥土中凝固的血跡。
你感覺到邪惡能量。這與阿哈特有關嗎？
你收集了凝固的血痕。

scripts.text:
There is something stuck by the frost on the sharp, crack surface.
You take a closer look and see it looks like the skin of a creature that crawls on the ground.
You feel evil energy. Does this have anything to do with Ahat?
You collect the clotted bloodstains.
scripts.translation:
在鋒利的裂縫表面的霜凍中粘著什麼東西。
你仔細一看，看起來像是某種在地面爬行的生物的皮膚。
你感覺到邪惡能量。這與阿哈特有關嗎？
你收集了凝固的血痕。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. I may need to discuss these with Shay.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

呻吟...呻吟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you alright?
You don't look well. Do you need help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你沒事吧？
你看起來氣色不好。需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Ah... thank you.
It's because of my injured leg.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
啊...謝謝你。
是因為我的腿受傷了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Do you mind helping me get to the building over there?
I will feel better if I rest a little.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
你介意幫我去那邊的大樓嗎？
如果能休息一下，我會感覺好一些。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I'm getting tired. Can we continue talking inside.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我有點累了。我們進去繼續聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
How is my little favor going?
We can have a chat after you are done with it.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我的那個小忙辦得怎麼樣了？
等你忙完我們可以聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
{0}, the guys said they wanted to meet up together sometime.
Make sure you ckear your schedule.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
{0}，大家說想找個時間聚在一起。
記得安排好你的日程。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Moan... moan...
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呻吟...呻吟...

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Zzz...Zzz...

[Frede]
Phew...
Thank you so much.
I'm glad I got a shot of the ^f57d7dBradium^000000 before it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
呼...
非常感謝。
幸好趕在太晚之前注射了^f57d7d魔力之石^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huff...Huff...
I'm glad that you feel better.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呼...呼...
很高興你感覺好些了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh my!! Why are you sweating so much!
You look a little pale too......
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
天哪！你怎麼出這麼多汗！
你的臉色看起來也有點蒼白......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it's nothing.
I'm only a little tired, that's all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒事，沒什麼。
我只是有點累而已。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Here, sit and eat this.
The cats outside gave it to me. It doesn't do much good for Saphas but I heard it's suppose to help you humans.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
來，坐下吃點這個。
外面的貓給我的。這對薩法沒什麼好處，但我聽說這對你們人類有幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But the injury on your leg doesn't look new. Why did you come out with a wounded leg?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你腿上的傷看起來不像是新傷。為什麼帶著傷腿還出來？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I can still move around with this leg and I wanted to help the village.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
這條腿還能走動，我想幫助村莊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you should stay home and recover.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你應該待在家裡休養。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
The fact is, my leg will never recover.
I can only keep my injury from getting worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
事實是，我的腿永遠好不了了。
我只能防止傷勢惡化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But I'm grateful that I can still move around.
Ha......
When did we start to be afraid of 'death'.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但我感激自己還能走動。
哈......
我們是從什麼時候開始害怕“死亡”的？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Saphas have never had any 'sicknesses' and we don't die unless there is a terrible accident.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
薩法從未有過“疾病”，除非遭遇可怕的事故，否則我們不會死亡。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
This is also the reason why we Saphas can maintain a perfect community.
We didn't have to be greedy.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
這也是我們薩法能維持完美社群的原因。
我們不需要貪婪。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But suddenly we are hit with this epidemic and many Saphas have lost their loved ones ever since.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但突然爆發了這場瘟疫，許多薩法失去了親人。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We weren't prepared for such a disaster.
It was chaos. Nobody knew what to do but watch them die.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我們對這樣的災難毫無準備。
一片混亂。除了眼睜睜看著他們死去，誰也不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
It was worse for us because we never experienced death from getting old.
I also thought my ^f57d7dStill Friends^000000 would wake up one day.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
對我們來說更糟，因為我們從未經歷過老死。
我也曾以為我的^f57d7d摯友^000000有一天會醒來。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
But after a while, we realized it was a sickness that led to death and started to search for a cure but the situation was out of control.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但過了一段時間，我們意識到這是一種致死疾病，並開始尋找治療方法，但局勢已經失控。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
We are very advanced in science technology but we lack knowledge in the medical field.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我們在科技方面非常先進，但在醫學領域缺乏知識。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
A medicine was completed only after we lost many lives but it isn't enough to completely cure the sickness.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
在失去許多生命之後，藥物才研製出來，但它不足以完全治癒這種疾病。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
As long as I don't forget to take my Bradium, I can keep from getting any worse.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
只要我不忘記服用魔力之石，就能防止病情惡化。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I recently did some ^f57d7drepair work in the cave next to the village^000000, but I forgot to take Bradium while I was working.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我最近去^f57d7d村莊旁邊的洞穴^000000做了一些修復工作，但工作時忘了服用魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I usually carry extra Bradium with me when I go outside of town for work but you can easily lose sense of time in a cave.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我通常外出工作時都會隨身攜帶備用的魔力之石，但在洞穴裡很容易忘記時間。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh no!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Come... to think of it....
My friends!!!!!!!!!!

[Frede]
I haven't seen my friends who I worked with in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
我還沒見到和我一起在洞穴工作的朋友們。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
They have to return to the village once every few days to replenish their Bradium.
Maybe......they forgot?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
他們每隔幾天就要回村莊補充魔力之石。
也許......他們忘了？

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Oh... what should I do......
I would run there myself if only my legs would move normally.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
啊...我該怎麼辦......
要是我的腿能正常活動，我早就親自跑過去了。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Would you mind visiting the cave to see if my friends are alright?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
你介意去洞穴看看我的朋友們是否平安嗎？

scripts.text: Will do.
scripts.translation: 我會去的。

scripts.text: No can't do.
scripts.translation: 我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
Thank you so much.
My memory is a bit fuzzy since its been a while since I came back to the village,
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
非常感謝。
因為離開村莊已經有一段時間了，我的記憶有些模糊，

scripts.text:
[Frede]
but you will find a ^f57d7dcave nearby the village with repairmen work going on^000000.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
但你在村莊附近就能找到一個^f57d7d正在進行修復工作的洞穴^000000。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I only hope they are all healthy and well.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德]
只希望他們都健康平安。

scripts.text:
[Frede]
I guess I can't do anything about it.
But drag myself there.
scripts.translation:

只能拖著身子過去看看。

他讓你來做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他讓我把魔力之石交給在村莊外洞穴工作的朋友們。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Oh no. I don't have any portable Bradium because of insufficient supplies.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
糟糕。由於補給不足，我這裡沒有可攜帶的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I will only be able to get the Bradium that is being refined now in a few days. We let Pioms returning from outside work stay and rest in the village.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
目前正在精煉的魔力之石還要幾天才能完成。我們讓從外面回來的皮奧姆在村裡休息。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But I see they haven't returned yet.
They must be out of Bradium by now.
This isn't good.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
但我看他們還沒回來。
他們現在的魔力之石肯定已經用完了。
這不好。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Worst case, they wouldn't come back to the village at all.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
最壞的情況是，他們根本不會回到村裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there another way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
還有其他辦法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
It takes a lot of time to refine a large Bradium mineral but small pieces of Bradium will be quick.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
精煉大塊魔力之石需要很長時間，但小塊魔力之石很快就能完成。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Bradium mineral can be collected anywhere in this area but the effectiveness of refined pieces is low.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
在這個區域任何地方都能採集魔力之石，但精煉後的小塊效果較低。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You can easily collect ^f57d7dpieces of Bradium from monsters nearby^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
你可以輕鬆地從附近的魔物身上掉落^f57d7d魔力之石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
About ^f57d7d30 pieces of Bradium^000000 will be enough to share with 6 people.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
大約^f57d7d30塊魔力之石碎片^000000就足夠6個人分享了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
You've brought back the Bradium.
I've been waiting for the Galtens to return because I'm not accustomed to battle since I'm Venknick. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
你帶回了魔力之石。
我一直在等加爾滕們回來，因為我是文克尼克，不習慣戰鬥。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Handwork is much faster to refine pieces of Bradium instead of using a machine. I will only need two hours to finish.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
手工精煉魔力之石碎片比使用機器快得多。我只需要兩個小時就能完成。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Please go rest while I get to work.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
請去休息，我去工作。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Bradium mineral can be collected anywhere in this area but the effectiveness of refined pieces is low.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
在這個區域任何地方都能採集魔力之石，但精煉後的小塊效果較低。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I did it!
I was a bit nervous because it has been a long time since I did manual work but I think I did a good job.
Please take these to them.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
完成了！
因為很久沒做手工了，我有點緊張，但我覺得做得不錯。
請把這些交給他們。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
I'm still working on it so please rest a little more.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我還在工作中，請再多休息一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
Saphas cannot live unless we consume Bradium continuously.
That is why we needed spaces for us to inject Bradium all over the village.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
薩法族如果不持續攝取魔力之石就無法生存。
所以我們需要在村莊各處設定注入魔力之石的空間。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But those working outside of the village cannot return often to refill their Bradium so we provide Bradium that is portable.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
但在村莊外工作的人無法經常回來補充魔力之石，所以我們提供行動式的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
But there was a problem with the Bradium mining in the Manuk area recently and we have a shortage of supplies. We don't have enough to give out.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
但最近馬努克地區的魔力之石開採出了問題，導致供應短缺。我們手頭沒有足夠的庫存可以發放。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
That is why many Pioms working in the outskirts of the village return for more supplies,
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
這就是為什麼許多在村莊外圍工作的皮奧姆族要頻繁回來領取補給，

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
and the time spent on transportation is what is slowing down work.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
而花在運輸上的時間拖慢了工作進度。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
To tell you the truth, transportation time doesn't make much difference but it adds up in the end.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
說實話，單次運輸時間的差異並不大，但累積起來就很可觀了。

scripts.text:
[Bouy]
We call this the ^f57d7dCreamy Effect^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布伊]
我們將這種現象稱為^f57d7d克瑞米效應^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maha]
But I do think the Sapha race is overly kind, almost unnaturally.
Guess it'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
但我總覺得薩法族過於善良了，簡直有些不自然。
不過應該沒事吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
There is nothing strange!
I'd love to be like you and respected by many people.
scripts.translation:
[本]
沒有什麼奇怪的！
我倒是很想成為像你那樣，受到許多人尊敬的人。

[Ben]

scripts.translation:

只要我在這裡工作表現好，也能去拜訪薩法族，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ben]

what do you think?
Why do you think he is here?

[本]
嗯。嘿，瑪哈，
你怎麼看？
你覺得他為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]

scripts.translation:

你不覺得那個人很奇怪嗎？
在我加入探險隊之前，我從未見過他的種族。

scripts.text:

There must be a reason why he is here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
啊。是嗎？
那就只有你一個人了。
他出現在這裡肯定是有原因的。

scripts.text:

All we need to do is wait for the announcement.
It will give us the answers.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]

我們要做的只是等待公告。
到時候一切就清楚了。

scripts.text: What is it?

scripts.text: Stay silent and listen.

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
