That tree-like giant race called Sapha are kind.
There won't be any trouble. Relax.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈]
據我所知，
那個樹狀的巨人種族薩法是友善的。
不會有什麼麻煩。放心吧。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Huh? Did you hear us?
Nothing really or maybe something...
So...
scripts.translation:
[本]
咦？你聽到我們說話了？
沒什麼大事，也許有一點...
所以...

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Research members dispatched to Manuk just came back.
But...
scripts.translation:
[本]
派往馬努克的研究成員剛剛回來了。
但是...

scripts.text: But?
scripts.translation: 但是？

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Well... they came back with a Manuk messenger!
...Sapha of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[本]
嗯...他們帶回了馬努克的信使！
...馬努克的薩法。

scripts.text: Where is he?!
scripts.translation: 他在哪裡？！

scripts.text: Is this top secret information?!
scripts.translation: 這是最高機密嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ben]
He's in the command center right now.
We should go there.
scripts.translation:
[本]
他就在指揮中心。
我們該去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Excuse me.
There was no order to restrict or keep it a secret.
And it looks like they are making an official visit.
scripts.translation:
[本]
抱歉。
並沒有下達限制或保密的命令。
而且看起來他們是在進行正式訪問。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
We might be able to know something if we go to the command center now
Try seeing ^4d4dffAello^000000.
scripts.translation:
[本]
如果我們現在去指揮中心，也許能瞭解到一些情況。
試著去見見^4d4dff艾洛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Ah, you. Good timing.
I have something urgent to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
啊，是你。來得正好。
我有件急事要告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Do you happen to know that a messenger from Manuk is here?
Not a big secret but..
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
你知道馬努克的信使來了嗎？
這不是什麼大秘密，但是...

scripts.text:
[Aello]
The Sapha from Manuk wants to talk to you.
Agiff says anyone of from the expedition can meet him but..
I think someone with more experience should go.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
馬努克的薩法想和你談談。
阿吉夫說遠征隊的任何人都可以見他，但是...
我覺得應該派更有經驗的人去。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I know your abilities
and trust you.
The delegation is in the room at the right on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我知道你的能力，
也信任你。
代表團在二樓右邊的房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
There will be a guard standing in front
just tell him you got authorization.
He is interested in humans, so try to be courteous while talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
門口會有衛兵站崗，
告訴他你已獲得授權即可。
他對人類很感興趣，所以交談時請保持禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
It's the room at the right on the second floor.
There is a guard in front of the room.
He'll let you pass if you tell him you have authorization.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
是二樓右邊的房間。
房間前面有衛兵。
告訴他你已獲得授權，他就會放行。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
Try not to give unnecessary information
and only do small talk.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
儘量不要提供不必要的資訊，
只進行寒暄即可。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I knew I could count on you.
You're activities will help us tremendously in expanding our territory.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我就知道可以指望你。
你的行動將極大地幫助我們擴充套件領土。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
I am only interested in the most skillful
and trustworthy person among the Ash-Vacuum expedition.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
我只對阿什-真空遠征隊中
最熟練且最值得信賴的人感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Aello]
But.. you are a new face around here.
Hmm... sorry but you won't do.
You'll have to get yourself familiar with this camp first.
scripts.translation:
[艾洛]
但是...你是這裡的新面孔。
嗯...抱歉，你不行。
你得先熟悉一下這個營地。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry, but this room is currently restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉，這個房間目前禁止訪客進入。

scripts.text: I have authorization.
scripts.translation: 我有授權

scripts.text: Is that so.
scripts.translation: 是嗎

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You do?
What is your name.
Thank you.
So you are {0}.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你有嗎？
請報上您的名字。
謝謝。
原來您是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You may go in now.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您現在可以進去了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You mustn't enter without Aello's permission.
No exceptions.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
未經艾洛許可，不得入內。
沒有任何例外。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You're back.
Are you acquainted with the Sapha messenger now?
We have high expectations from you.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
您回來了。
您現在認識薩法的信使了嗎？
我們對您寄予厚望。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Sorry.
This room is restricted from visitors.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
抱歉。
此房間禁止訪客進入。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Let's continue..
Although the details are already settled.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我們繼續...
雖然細節已經定下來了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ah, yes.
Where was I?
Ah, yes.
El Dicastes!
El Dicastes is the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
啊，是的。
我剛才說到哪了？
啊，是的。
艾爾迪卡斯特！
艾爾迪卡斯特是薩法的首都。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
A city like a sparkling jewel in white snow.
Manuk was originally a village created to mine Bradium.
El Dicastes has now grown to be the Sapha home ground.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
一座如白雪中閃耀寶石般的城市。
馬努克最初是一個為了開採魔力之石而建立的村莊。
如今，艾爾迪卡斯特已經發展成為薩法的大本營。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail holds all authority in El Dicastes
and makes decisions on reports from Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
拉維爾在艾爾迪卡斯特擁有最高權力，
並根據馬努克的報告做出決策。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Kind race born from a world other than ours
we are grateful for your kindness
in helping and cooperating with us.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
來自我們世界之外的友善種族，
感謝你們對我們的幫助與合作。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail, representative of Sapha
would like to invite humans to El Dicastes,
Sapha's capital city.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
薩法的代表拉維爾
希望邀請人類前往艾爾迪卡斯特，
也就是薩法的首都。

scripts.text: Invite? Visit? City?!
scripts.translation: 邀請？參觀？城市？！

scripts.text: What is that suppose to mean, Hound?
scripts.translation: 這是什麼意思，獵犬？

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Just as he said.
Our expedition team has helped the Saphas for some time.
Collect Bradium for their survival or
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
正如他所說。
我們的遠征隊已經幫助薩法一段時間了。
為他們的生存收集魔力之石，或者

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Eliminate vicious beasts that threaten them.
.. ......
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
消滅威脅他們的兇惡野獸。
.. ......

scripts.text:
[Hound]
So they have given us an official invitation to visit their capital city in return.
That is why I've been selecting expedition members to send to El Dicastes, the capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
作為回報，他們正式邀請我們訪問他們的首都。
這就是我為什麼一直在挑選遠征隊成員，派往薩法的首都艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text: ..You mean..
scripts.translation: ..你的意思是..

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Yes.
That is what he meant.
Agiff also approved before he left.
{0}, you are invited.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
是的。
他的意思就是這個。
阿吉夫離開前也批准了。
{0}，您被邀請了。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are kind and respect others
polite and trustworthy and most of all, fun in character.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
您善良且尊重他人，
彬彬有禮，值得信賴，
最重要的是，您風趣幽默。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You are perfect. Ravail will approve too.
That is why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
您完美無缺。拉維爾也會贊同的。
這就是我在此的原因。

scripts.text: Never would have imagined.
scripts.translation: 我從未想過。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Shouldn't you already be used to the unexpected by now?
Come on... you're not a rookie.. haha.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
難道您不應該已經習慣這種意外了嗎？
拜託...您可不是新人...哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
If you are going to leave, better be now.
Come back to me once you are ready to leave.
I will let you know your mission.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
如果您要離開，最好現在就動身。
當您準備好出發時，請回來找我。
我會告知您任務詳情。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
First go to Manuk and meet General Guard Avalanche.
Avalanche will be heavily armed because he is Galten.
You can't miss him.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
首先前往馬努克，會見衛兵隊長雪崩。
雪崩會全副武裝，因為他是加爾滕。
您不會認不出他的。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Once you tell Avalanche that you are a guest of the city, he will let you pass the path to El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
一旦您告訴雪崩您是城市的客人，他就會允許您通過前往艾爾迪卡斯特的道路。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You cannot go pass without his approval so make sure you get his permission.
He will let you pass with my recommendations.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
沒有他的批准您無法通過，所以務必獲得他的許可。
憑藉我的推薦，他會讓您通過的。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
I'm a little excited.
on what our meeting will bring in the future.
Only hope it won't be like a blizzard in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我有點興奮，
期待這次會面在未來會帶來什麼。
只希望不會像深夜的暴風雪一樣。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
My name is Hound.
Are you here by Aello's request?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我的名字是獵犬。
您是應艾洛的請求來的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. He told me to meet the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 是的。他讓我來見薩法。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Okay. You should be able to talk to him, right?
Shall we start with introducing ourselves?
This is...
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
好的。您應該能和他交談，對吧？
我們要不先互相介紹一下？
這位是...
{0}...

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
My name is Vyhannus.
{0}..?
Glad to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我的名字是維漢努斯。
{0}..？
很高興見到您。

scripts.text: Same here.
scripts.translation: 彼此彼此。

scripts.text: A tree monster!
scripts.translation: 樹魔物！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Amazing.
Like with Hound, that ring you humans made...
is like a ring of wisdom.
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
令人驚歎。
就像獵犬一樣，你們人類製作的那個戒指...
就像智慧之戒。
[維漢努斯]
我們要不直接進入正題？
我在此的原因...

scripts.text:
[Hound]
What are you saying?
That was rude!
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
你在說什麼？
太無禮了！

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh. Monster?
That is something new.
Hound. I'm fine. You humans are amusing.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
哦。魔物？
這可是新鮮事。
獵犬。我沒事。你們人類真有趣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Shall we skip to the point?
The reason why I am here...
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我們要不直接進入正題？
我在此的原因...

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
Excuse me, hold on a second.
scripts.translation:
[某人的聲音]
打擾一下，請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Commander!
You've come at such short notice.
Is there a situation?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
指揮官！
您來得好突然。
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Huh? Nothing.
Was there anything.
You said you wanted to send a trustworthy person, right?
I wanted to see the person Aello chosen to send.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯？沒什麼。
你剛才說想派個可靠的人去，對吧？
我想看看艾洛選中的那個人是誰。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hm... Ah.
Is it you?
I see, just as Aello explained.
Well, I think we are in good hands if it is you.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯...啊。
原來是你啊。
看來正如艾洛所說的那樣。
如果是你的話，我想我們交給你了。

scripts.text: What are you implying?
scripts.translation: 你這話是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
So... It's like this.
Both Saphas and humans had many differences in the past.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
是這樣的。
過去，薩法族和人類之間有很多差異。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We've worried about becoming enemies with your race after you've suddenly appeared
and were afraid of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你們突然出現後，我們擔心會與你們種族成為敵人，
並且對你們的能力感到恐懼。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
But you have respected us Saphas
and helped Manuk with many deeds.
We've come to recognize humans as good people.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
但你們尊重我們薩法族，
併為馬努克做出了許多貢獻。
我們開始認可人類是善良的人。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Yes, we made efforts.
We also tried to keep a neutral attitude.
Because it is always better to strengthen amnity as a third party then taking sides in a conflict.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
是的，我們也付出了努力。
我們也試圖保持中立的態度。
因為在衝突中，作為第三方加強友好關係總比選邊站要好。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Well..
Not totally wrong, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
嗯...
也不能說完全不對...

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
(Vyhannus smiles)
We have told Ravail about you humans.
Ravail is the highest elder of glorious ^4d4dffEl Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
(維漢努斯微笑)
我們已經向拉維爾介紹了你們人類。
拉維爾是光輝^4d4dff艾爾·迪卡斯特^000000的最高長老。

scripts.text: El Dicastes?
scripts.translation: 艾爾·迪卡斯特？

scripts.text: Ravail?
scripts.translation: 拉維爾？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, sorry for interrupting.
I have to go now.
Hound, I approve.
I think he will do just fine.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，抱歉打斷了。
我得走了。
獵犬，我批准了。
我覺得他會做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Then it's settled with him.
And... ah yes, you.
Please go meet the inspector in the next room after this.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那就決定是他了。
還有...啊對了，你。
結束後請去隔壁房間見檢查員。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'm leaving now.
Vyhannus? I'll come by to see you again.
And you should ^4d4dffmeet Inspector Doha after talking with Vyhannus^000000.
Then bye everyone.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我要走了。
維漢努斯？我之後會再來拜訪你。
還有，你應該^4d4dff在和維漢努斯交談後去見檢查員道哈^000000。
那麼，大家再見。

scripts.text:
Commander Hibba Agip quickly left the room after saying what he wanted to say.
First, let's listen to Vyhannus's story.
scripts.translation:
指揮官希巴·阿吉普說完話後迅速離開了房間。
首先，讓我們聽聽維漢努斯的故事。

scripts.text: -Looks like the Sapha messenger from Manuk.-
scripts.translation: -看起來像是來自馬努克的薩法族信使。-

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Sorry but will you leave now?
You don't seem to have authorization from the captain or Aello?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
抱歉，請你現在離開嗎？
你似乎沒有獲得船長或艾洛的授權？

scripts.text:
[Sapha]
- This person look like the Sapha messenger from Manuk. -
You just stand there without
knowing what he says, so the
expedition guard next to you starts to talk. -
scripts.translation:
[薩法]
- 這個人看起來像是來自馬努克的薩法族信使。-
你只是站在那裡，不知道他在說什麼，
於是你旁邊的探險隊衛兵開始說話了。-

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Your commander is like the wind.
We have someone like that in Manuk, too.
He's name is Galten. He is so quick, you won't notice the weight of his armor.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你的指揮官就像風一樣。
馬努克也有這樣的人。
他叫加爾滕。他動作極快，你甚至感覺不到他盔甲的重量。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Avalanche will be at the Manuk Operations building.
Once he approves, you can use the tunnel that leads to the capital city.
The tunnel might be a little scary.
But I'm sure you will reach the end of it since you are strong.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
雪崩會在馬努克運營大樓。
一旦他批准，你就可以使用通往首都的隧道。
隧道可能會讓人有點害怕。
但既然你很強大，我相信你能走到盡頭。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh, the tunnel?
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
哦，隧道？
它原本是一座礦石礦。
但我們在挖掘時，發現自己到了另一側。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
The tunnel is reorganized with paths between the capital city and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
後來我們發現了更好的礦脈，馬努克就是這樣形成的。
隧道被重新整理，成為了連線首都和馬努克的通道。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
That is it.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
You received the Light of El Dicastes.
With this, you can return to Diel from anywhere, anytime.
Looks like an item made for your convenience.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你獲得了埃迪斯特斯之光。
有了它，你可以隨時從任何地方返回迪爾。
看起來是個為你方便而製作的物品。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Ravail seems to like you very much.
The Light of El Dicastes is convenient to use instead of moving through long tunnels.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
拉維爾似乎非常喜歡你。
比起穿過漫長的隧道，使用埃迪斯特斯之光更方便。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
Oh, the tunnel?
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
哦，隧道？
它原本是一座礦石礦。
但我們在挖掘時，發現自己到了另一側。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
The tunnel is reorganized with paths between the capital city and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
後來我們發現了更好的礦脈，馬努克就是這樣形成的。
隧道被重新整理，成為了連線首都和馬努克的通道。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
That is it.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
The tunnel that connects Manuk and the capital city.
It was originally a mineral mine.
But we found ourselves on the opposite side while mining away.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
連線馬努克和首都的隧道。
它原本是一座礦石礦。
但我們在挖掘時，發現自己到了另一側。

scripts.text:
[Vyhannus]
We found better mines afterwards and that is how Manuk came about.
The tunnel is reorganized with paths between the capital city and Manuk.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
後來我們發現了更好的礦脈，馬努克就是這樣形成的。
隧道被重新整理，成為了連線首都和馬努克的通道。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Where is your interpreter ring?
I'm not going to be your personal translator.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
你的翻譯戒指呢？
我可不想當你的私人翻譯。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Where is the interpreter ring?
We should create it if we don't have one.
I would like to speak in person.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
翻譯戒指在哪裡？
如果沒有，我們應該製作一個。
我想直接對話。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Sorry but will you leave now?
You don't seem to have authorization from the captain or Aello?
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
抱歉，請你現在離開嗎？
你似乎沒有獲得船長或艾洛的授權？

scripts.text:
[Hound]
First thing you need to do when you reach Manuk is to meet General Guard Avalanche.
Tell Avalanche that you are the one invited by Vyhannus.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
你到達馬努克後首先要做的事，是去見衛隊長雪崩。
告訴雪崩，你是受維漢努斯邀請而來的。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
Then you'll go through a simply process of confirmation and will be permitted to go through the tunnel to the capital city.
Passing through the tunnel is easy as long as you are polite.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
然後你會經過一個簡單的確認流程，並被允許通過隧道前往首都。
只要你有禮貌，通過隧道很容易。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
And don't forget what the captain said.
Inspector Doha is in the next room.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
別忘了船長說的話。
檢查員道哈在隔壁房間。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I've just returned from Manuk from a long term dispatch
and haven't gotten any rest yet.
El Dicastes.. I will find the time to visit once your advance party settles in.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我剛從馬努克長期外派回來，
還沒得到休息。
埃迪斯特斯...等你的先遣隊安頓好後，我會找時間拜訪。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I have to take care of Vyhannus here.
We might see the day when Saphas like Vyhannus will be living with us on our continent.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我得在這裡照顧維漢努斯。
也許有一天，像維漢努斯這樣的薩法族會和我們生活在這片大陸上。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I've just returned from Manuk from a long term dispatch
and haven't gotten any rest yet.
El Dicastes.. I will find the time to visit once your advance party settles in.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我剛從馬努克長期外派回來，
還沒得到休息。
埃迪斯特斯...等你的先遣隊安頓好後，我會找時間拜訪。

scripts.text:
[Hound]
I have to take care of Vyhannus here.
We might see the day when Saphas like Vyhannus will be living with us on our continent.
scripts.translation:
[獵犬]
我得在這裡照顧維漢努斯。
也許有一天，像維漢努斯這樣的薩法族會和我們生活在這片大陸上。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Hmm..?
I should go now.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
嗯..？
我該走了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
�����? �� ����...
���� �� ?
���..?

[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
You are human.
What do you want here?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
你是人類。
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Go out of this building and straight below the mountain east from the village.
You will know where it is if you see soldiers guarding the tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
走出這棟建築，沿著村莊東側的山腳一直走。
如果你看到士兵在守衛隧道，就知道地方了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
Oh... You have the Light of El Dicastes.
it would be helpful for your travel.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
哦...你有埃迪斯特斯之光。
這對你的旅途會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Guard Captain Avalanche]
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的道路以前是礦道。
雖然隧道維護得很好，但我們仍收到過野生魔物出現的報告。

scripts.text: I've come with Vyhannus's invitation.
scripts.translation: 我是受維漢努斯邀請來的。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Ah. Jarute Vyhannus.
I thought it would be better for him to take a guard with him but.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
啊。賈魯特·維漢努斯。
我原本覺得讓他帶個衛兵一起走比較好，但是...

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I guess Vyhannus had trust in you humans.
I'm fine as long as Vyhannus approved you.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
看來維漢努斯很信任你們人類。
只要維漢努斯認可了你，我就沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I authorize you to pass through to El Dicastes, the capital city.
There is a tunnel that leads to the capital city right outside this building which goes down by the east mountain range of this village.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
我授權你通過前往首都埃迪斯特斯。
就在這個建築外面，有一條通往首都的隧道，它沿著本村東側的山脈向下延伸。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
It is a tunnel that reaches the capital city. There is no other detour because Kamidal mountain is so huge.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
這是一條通往首都的隧道。因為卡米達爾山脈非常巨大，沒有其他繞路。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The tunnel is well maintained but there was a time when part of the tunnel which connects
with the lowest cave of the mountain collapsed and reports of wild monsters was received.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
隧道維護得很好，但曾經有一段連線山體最深處洞穴的隧道坍塌過，並收到了野生魔物出現的報告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
So I recommend that you move in a group.
It is dangerous and can be a long journey.
That is all I have to say for now.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
所以我建議你們結伴而行。
那裡很危險，而且路途遙遠。
目前我就說這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Please let me know any news about the capital city when you come back.
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
等你回來時，請告訴我首都的訊息。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
I hope that the Light of El Dicastes will show you the way.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
希望埃迪斯特斯之光能為你指引方向。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的道路以前是礦道。
雖然隧道維護得很好，但我們仍收到過野生魔物出現的報告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Always take care of yourself at all times.
Haha.. but then you humans are very strong.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
請時刻注意安全。
哈哈...不過你們人類很強壯。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
The path to the capital city was previously a mine.
so we have reports of wild monsters appearing although the tunnel is well maintained.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
通往首都的道路以前是礦道。
雖然隧道維護得很好，但我們仍收到過野生魔物出現的報告。

scripts.text:
[Avalanche]
Always take care of yourself at all times.
Haha... but then you humans are very strong.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長 雪崩]
[雪崩]
請時刻注意安全。
哈哈...不過你們人類很強壯。

scripts.text: - Cannot communicate with him. -
scripts.translation: - 無法與他交流。 -

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: Register as an adventurer.
scripts.translation: 註冊為冒險者

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Do you want to register as an adventurer?
Strange.
You are not on our list of visitors.
Did you enter without permission?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想註冊為冒險者？
奇怪。
您不在我們的訪客名單上。
您是未經許可進入的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
All other races without official permission are restricted.
I will send for a Galten right away.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
所有其他種族若無官方許可均被限制進入。
我馬上叫一個加爾滕過來。

scripts.text:
The Sapha clerk is ready to call on a Guard Galten any time.
It's best to avoid this situation.
scripts.translation:
薩法的職員隨時都可以呼叫衛兵加爾滕。
最好避免這種情況發生。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Do you want to register as an adventurer?
I will compare with the invitation list from Manuk.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想註冊為冒險者？
我會核對來自馬努克的邀請名單。
請問您貴姓？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Yes.. {0}...
I found it.
Welcome to El Dicastes, capital city of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
是的...{0}...
我找到了。
歡迎來到薩法的首都艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You will be treated the same as other Saphas here
and is allowed to do as you wish
and can have contracts with official requests from Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
在這裡，您將受到與其他薩法同等的待遇，
可以隨心所欲地行動，
也可以接受來自艾爾迪卡斯特的官方委託。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
This is a little souvenir for visiting El Dicastes.
You can use it to return to El Dicastes whenever you wish.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
這是您訪問艾爾迪卡斯特的紀念品。
您可以隨時使用它返回艾爾迪卡斯特。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
There is a special place for humans located beneath the residential area of Pioms.
It is called in your language...
Pub. Hope you get to visit there.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
在皮奧姆居住區的下方，有一處專門供人類使用的地方。
用你們的語言來說...
叫酒館。希望您能去那裡坐坐。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Strange.
Aren't you already registered?
I see your name in the records.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
奇怪。
您不是已經註冊過了嗎？
我在記錄裡看到了您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
I recognize you.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
我認識您。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to meet the minister.
scripts.translation: 我想見大臣

scripts.text: Nothing particular.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You want to meet the minister?
Which minister?
Ravail cannot be met in person even with exploit certifications.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您想見大臣？
哪位大臣？
即使持有功勳證明，也無法面見拉維爾。

scripts.text: Ahat
scripts.translation: 阿哈特

scripts.text: Another minister
scripts.translation: 另一位大臣

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You've really collected 3 exploit certification of Sapha already.
Alright. I will send a request.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您竟然已經收集了3個薩法的功勳證明。
好吧。我會提交申請。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please take the elevator up to the Administrative Office.
There is another elevator in the corridor next to the Administrative Office.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
請乘坐電梯前往行政辦公室。
行政辦公室旁邊的走廊裡還有另一部電梯。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
It is a separate elevator that leads to the high minister's office
You will be guided in front of the office.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
那是通往高階大臣辦公室的專用電梯。
您會被引導到辦公室門口。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You need 3 exploit certification of Sapha to meet Ahat.
You know what exploit certification of Sapha is, right?
Well, please try to help around El Dicastes to collect them.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您需要3個薩法的功勳證明才能面見阿哈特。
您知道什麼是薩法的功勳證明吧？
嗯，請嘗試在艾爾迪卡斯特幫忙收集它們。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Another minister? Who?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
另一位大臣？是誰？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I know no one else.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不認識其他人

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
You are difficult.
Unlike other Saphas, ministers are very busy.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
您真難纏。
與其他薩法不同，大臣們非常忙碌。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What are you curious about today?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
今天您想了解些什麼？

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is on the same floor as high minister Ravail.
Take the elevator up to the Administrative Office and then you will be guided in front of the separate elevator.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
阿哈特與高階大臣拉維爾在同一層樓。
請乘坐電梯前往行政辦公室，之後會有人引導您到專用電梯前。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What are you curious about today?
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
今天您想了解些什麼？

scripts.text: About official requests
scripts.translation: 關於官方委託

scripts.text: About the adventurer's pub
scripts.translation: 關於冒險者酒館

scripts.text: Ahat?
scripts.translation: 阿哈特？

scripts.text: Exploit certification of Sapha?
scripts.translation: 薩法的功勳證明？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
If Diel or ministers need help on operations in the capital
they post a notice on the public board.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
如果迪爾或大臣們需要協助處理首都的事務，
他們會在公告板上釋出告示。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Anyone who can take the job can take up the request.
Adventurers who are officially registered can also take jobs.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
任何有能力的人都可以接受這些委託。
正式註冊的冒險者也可以接取任務。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
After you handle a request
you are given an exploit certification for helping El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
完成委託後，
您會獲得一份功勳證明，以表彰您對艾爾迪卡斯特的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
It is better spend spare time on these official requests.
Because you are contributing to the community.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
建議您利用空閒時間處理這些官方委託。
因為您是在為社群做貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Due to the increase of visitors from other worlds,
some requests are targeted for you.
You can take your pick.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
由於來自其他世界的訪客增多，
部分委託是專門為您準備的。
您可以自由選擇。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
The adventurer's pub is open for the convenience of visitors like you.
It is located in the Piom residential area below the mine and factory zone.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
為了方便像您這樣的訪客，我們開設了冒險者酒館。
它位於礦山和工廠區下方的皮奧姆居住區。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
We thought the living environment here would be unfamiliar and inconvenient for you.
So we tried to make a place that is similar to what you have back home with a little help from adventurers.
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
我們覺得這裡的生活環境對您來說可能既陌生又不便。
所以在冒險者的幫助下，我們嘗試打造了一個類似您家鄉的地方。
希望您喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is the next minister in line after Ravail.
Why?
Because we respect her.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
阿哈特是繼拉維爾之後的下一位大臣。
為什麼？
因為我們要尊重她。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
What should I say, we would like to protect her.
But I'm not sure how respect is used in your language.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
該怎麼說呢，我們想要保護她。
不過我不確定在您的語言中“尊重”是如何表達的。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Ahat is popular.
Not many have seen him and he works in her room all the time.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
阿哈特很受歡迎。
很少有人見過他，他總是在房間裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
If you want to meet Ahat..well.
He is really good at his work but is very shy of strangers..
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
如果您想見阿哈特...嗯。
他工作非常出色，但非常怕生...

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
He doesn't like to be in places where a lot of people are gathered.
That is why we barely see her.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
他不喜歡人多擁擠的地方。
所以我們很少見到她。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Exploit certification?
Exploit certifications are made for outsiders like you.
They are given out as rewards when adventurers help with requests from Saphas throughout the city.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
功勳證明？
功勳證明是為您這樣的外來者準備的。
當冒險者協助處理薩法在城市各處釋出的委託時，會作為獎勵發放。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
The exploit certification is used to meet ministers.
I guess in order to meet busy ministers, you must at least contribute to our society.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
功勳證明用於面見大臣。
我想，為了見到大忙人大臣，您至少需要為我們的社會做出貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please feel free to ask questions when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
如果您需要幫助，請隨時提問。

scripts.text:
[Clerk Rhawyne]
Please feel free to ask questions when you need help.
scripts.translation:
[職員 羅溫]
如果您需要幫助，請隨時提問。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of items. Let's try again after you reduce the number of items.
scripts.translation: 你的物品種類太多了。請在減少物品數量後再試一次。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because the weight of your items is too heavy. Let's try again after you get rid of some weight.
scripts.translation: 由於您的物品重量過重，無法繼續。請在減輕負重後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Do you want to upgrade the ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 again?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您想再次強化^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
That will cost ^9900996 Sapha Certifications^000000 in order to retry.
And note this, your current Light of El Dicastes will be destroyed along with all of its enchantments.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
重試需要消耗^9900996個沙帕功勳證^000000。
請注意，您當前的埃迪斯特斯之光及其所有附魔都將被銷燬。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Are you sure you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您確定要這樣做嗎？

scripts.text: No, let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 不，讓我再想想。

scripts.text: Take my Light of El Dicastes.
scripts.translation: 把我的埃迪斯特斯之光交給你。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
You need to bring the Light of El Dicastes and 6 Sapha Certifications!
Don't try to cheat me!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您需要攜帶埃迪斯特斯之光和6個沙帕功勳證！
別想騙我！

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Ok, let's get this started.
I'm going to remove all enchantments from your Light of El Dicastes.
Haaap--!
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
好的，我們開始吧。
我將移除您埃迪斯特斯之光上的所有附魔。
哈啊--！

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
The Exploit Certifications of Sapha that you collect by helping throughout the city has other uses besides meeting the minister.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您通過協助城市事務獲得的沙帕功勳證，除了用於面見大臣外，還有其他用途。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
If you come across an exploit certification, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
如果您獲得了功勳證，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I can cast an additional spell to your ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 accessory.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我可以為您的^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000飾品附加額外的法術。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
You've come to awaken the ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000 infinite strength.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您是想喚醒^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000的無限力量。

scripts.text: Please explain.
scripts.translation: 請解釋一下。

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想強化它。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I heard some craftsmen outside of the city can also cast spells on equipment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我聽說城外的一些工匠也可以給裝備附加法術。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
I'm the same but at least I don't destroy equipment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
我和他們一樣，但至少我不會弄壞裝備。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
If you bring exploit certifications of Sapha, I will cast spells from 1 to 3 steps to your ^990099Light of El Dicastes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
如果您帶來沙帕功勳證，我會為您的^990099埃迪斯特斯之光^000000附加1到3級的法術。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
But of course, since this is adding spells on top of its original magic, I cannot guarantee that you will get what you want on one try.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
但當然，既然這是在原有魔法基礎上疊加法術，我無法保證您一次就能得到想要的結果。

scripts.text:
[Kareka]
Either you are not wearing or don't have the equipment to upgrade on you.
scripts.translation:
[卡雷卡]
您身上沒有穿戴或持有需要強化的裝備。

scripts.text:
{0}
It is difficult to find fish here. Can't find any so Jahbong would forget that he's busy or angry at the sight of a Fish Tail.
scripts.translation:
{0}
這裡很難找到魚。找不到魚的話，賈邦就會忘記自己很忙，或者看到魚尾時就會生氣。

scripts.text:
{0}
Grrr... I was punished with a ladle for peeing on my blanket yesterday.
scripts.translation:
{0}
咕嚕...昨天我尿在毯子上，被勺子打了一頓。

scripts.text:
{0}
I dream sometimes of a giant patting me on the head. But I feel more annoyed than afraid.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我有時會夢見一個巨人撫摸我的頭。但我感到的不是害怕，而是煩躁。

scripts.text:
{0}
Newbie Jarute, Ahat doesn't seem to look like a Sapha.
scripts.translation:
{0}
新手賈魯特，阿哈特看起來不像沙帕人。

scripts.text:
{0}
Our people say Ahat looks like a beautiful cat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我們的人說阿哈特看起來像一隻美麗的貓。

scripts.text:
{0}
I heard there was a superior equipment upgrade craftsman in the capital city of Manuk.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我聽說馬努克的首都有一位高明的裝備強化工匠。

scripts.text:
{0}
Grrr... I don't think my voice sounds normal these days. I think it's the weather.
scripts.translation:
{0}
咕嚕...我覺得最近我的聲音聽起來不太正常。我想是天氣的原因。

scripts.text:
{0}
There are times when I shout out loud but it is only because I am in a good mood. No need to be startled.
scripts.translation:
{0}
有時候我會大聲喊叫，但那只是因為我心情好。不用大驚小怪。

scripts.text:
{0}
I feel an urge to jump on a pile with my four paws when I see one.
scripts.translation:
{0}
看到一堆東西時，我就忍不住想用四隻爪子跳上去。

scripts.text:
{0}
I must have been a cat in my previous life.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我前世一定是一隻貓。

scripts.text:
{0}
I dreamt about the giant again. I waved my paws annoyed and he kept on patting me.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我又夢到那個巨人了。我煩躁地揮動爪子，他卻一直撫摸我。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yup!! Was the rumor true that Ahat looks like a human?!
scripts.translation:
{0}
沒錯！！阿哈特長得像人類的傳聞是真的嗎？！

scripts.text:
{0}
I heard on my way that this Pinqucula Dark has a Withered Flower.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我在路上聽說這隻捕蟲堇黑暗擁有凋謝的花。

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a guy named Pinguicula nearby who has the Sharp Leaf nearby.
scripts.translation:
{0}
附近有一個叫捕蟲堇的傢伙，身上有尖銳的葉子。

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a guy named Pinguicula nearby who has the Great Leaf nearby.
scripts.translation:
{0}
附近有一個叫捕蟲堇的傢伙，身上有大葉子。

scripts.text:
{0}
I recommend getting it from the Dracos nearby. But then, they only drop it randomly so you may come back empty handed...
scripts.translation:
{0}
我建議你去附近的飛龍那裡獲取。不過，它們只是隨機掉落，你可能會空手而歸...

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm... This may not be important to you but.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯...這對您來說可能並不重要，但是。

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh... no luck on Sapha Certifications?
scripts.translation:
{0}
噢...沒拿到沙帕功勳證嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
If you work hard in this city, you will get an Exploit Certification of Sapha.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您在這座城市努力工作，就能獲得沙帕功勳證。

scripts.text:
{0}
I've been gathering exploit certifications of Sapha for a year now to meet Ahat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
為了見到阿哈特，我已經收集沙帕功勳證一年了。

scripts.text:
{0}
Do you want to look luxurious with Golden Bells?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您想用寵物鈴鐺來炫耀一下嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
You must be interested in the ^800080Feral Tail^000000?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您一定對^800080狂野尾巴^000000很感興趣吧？

scripts.text:
{0}
You've come for Feral Boots. I have just the item for you.
scripts.translation:
{0}
您是來買狂野長靴的。我正好有您要的東西。

scripts.text:
{0}
So you haven't got any...
scripts.translation:
{0}
看來您還沒有...

scripts.text:
{0}
That's sad. They're very are useful, you know...
scripts.translation:
{0}
真遺憾。它們其實很有用的，您知道嗎...

scripts.text:
{0}
If you do come across one of the certifications, can you bring it to me?
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您找到了沙帕功勳證，能帶給我嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
We can make an exchange and you won't regret it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我們可以做個交換，您絕對不會後悔的。

scripts.text:
{0}
But I'm far from it because it takes a high position and some bribery for a low creature like me to meet him.
scripts.translation:
{0}
但我離那還很遠。像我這種低等生物，想要見他，需要很高的職位，還得行賄才行。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you have any exploit certifications of Sapha to spare, please share them with me. I promise to pay you back in services. You'll never get anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您有多餘的沙帕功勳證，請分給我一些。我保證用服務來回報您。您在別處絕對找不到這樣的待遇。

scripts.text: Please explain.
scripts.translation: 請解釋一下。

scripts.text: I want to reset.
scripts.translation: 我想重置

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想強化它。

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Golden Bell^000000 is an accessory awarded to only the best and bravest warriors among our people.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099寵物鈴鐺^000000是隻授予我們族中最優秀、最勇敢的戰士的飾品。

scripts.text:
{0}
A random skill is casted up to the first and second steps but
scripts.translation:
{0}
隨機技能可以強化到第一和第二級，但是

scripts.text:
{0}
There is a risk of the item breaking during the third upgrade.
scripts.translation:
{0}
在第三級強化時，物品有損壞的風險。

scripts.text:
{0}
You say you want me to explain about upgrade?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您說想讓我解釋一下強化的事？

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Feral Tail^000000 is an unique item. It looks just like our tails.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099狂野尾巴^000000是一件獨特的物品。它看起來就像我們的尾巴。

scripts.text:
{0}
It is not only strong and warm but is also powerful enough to be enchanted with magical spells.
scripts.translation:
{0}
它不僅堅固保暖，而且足夠強大，可以附魔多種魔法。

scripts.text:
[Mancho]
Well... it comes with the same risks as the ^990099Feral Boots^000000 of breaking at the third step of upgrade.
scripts.translation:
[曼喬]
嗯...它和^990099狂野長靴^000000一樣，在第三級強化時也有損壞的風險。

scripts.text:
{0}
You say you want me to explain about upgrade?
scripts.translation:
{0}
您說想讓我解釋一下強化的事？

scripts.text:
{0}
Hmm. The ^990099Feral Boots^000000 are very unique. A shoemaker took the design of our feet and designed this item long ago.
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯。^990099狂野長靴^000000非常獨特。很久以前，一位鞋匠參考了我們腳的設計，製作了這件物品。

scripts.text:
{0}
I do not know the actual materials used but they are strong enough to enchant up to 3 kinds of upgrade magic spells.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我不知道具體用了什麼材料，但它們足夠堅固，可以附魔多達3種強化魔法。

scripts.text:
{0}
Well... some do get broken at the third upgrade and I do have some customers complaining when that happens.......meow
scripts.translation:
{0}
嗯...有些在第三級強化時確實會損壞，我也有一些顧客在那時抱怨過.......喵

scripts.text:
{0}
... I almost died in one occasion. (murmuring)
scripts.translation:
{0}
...有一次我差點死了。（低聲說）

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text: Please reset it.
scripts.translation: 請重置它

scripts.text:
{0}
Then, take the equipment off first.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那麼，請先取下裝備。

scripts.text:
{0}
I've collected all equipment and erased all records as you requested. Now all your equipment and records are clean.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我已按您的要求收集了所有裝備並刪除了所有記錄。現在您的裝備和記錄都已清理乾淨。

scripts.text:
{0}
I only do what I'm asked to do. I've retrieved all equipment and cancelled all records.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我只是照做而已。我已取回所有裝備並取消了所有記錄。

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
first step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我正在準備第一步強化。
一旦裝備被強化，
在銷燬之前無法更改強化狀態。

scripts.text:
{0}
First upgrade step requires ^8000801 Sapha Certification^000000. Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
{0}
第一步強化需要^8000801 沙帕功勳證^000000。您要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
second step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我正在準備第二步強化。
一旦裝備被強化，
在銷燬之前無法更改強化狀態。

scripts.text:
{0}
Second upgrade step requires ^9900992 Exploit Certifications of Sapha^000000. Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
{0}
第二步強化需要^9900992 沙帕功勳證^000000。您要繼續嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm preparing for the
third step of upgrade.
Once equipment is upgraded
you cannot change the upgrade
before you destroy it.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我正在準備第三步強化。
一旦裝備被強化，
在銷燬之前無法更改強化狀態。

scripts.text:
{0}
And this is the most important,
the risk of equipment to break
during the third upgrade step is high!
And you need ^9900993 Exploit Certifications of Sapha^000000 for the procedure.
scripts.translation:
{0}
這是最重要的一步，
第三步強化時裝備損壞的風險很高！
並且您需要^9900993 沙帕功勳證^000000來進行此操作。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please keep in mind that
this is a delicate process of
casting immense power to the equipment.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
{0}
請記住，
這是一個向裝備註入巨大魔力的精細過程。
您準備好了嗎？

{0}
您已完成第三步強化。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you do not like
your equipment upgrade
I can withdraw your equipment
and destroy all records
of it
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您不喜歡
您的裝備強化結果，
我可以取回您的裝備
並銷燬所有相關記錄

scripts.text: I'll just use it.
scripts.translation: 我就這樣用

scripts.text: Please take it.
scripts.translation: 請取回

scripts.text:
{0}
I have erased all previous records
of upgrades to start all over with
any new equipment without upgrades
you bring.
Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text: I want to upgrade.
scripts.translation: 我想強化它。

scripts.text:
{0}
But you don't have enough exploit certifications. You need {1} exploit certification of Sapha for the {2} step of upgrade.
scripts.translation:
{0}
但是您的功勳證數量不足。進行第{2}步強化需要{1}張沙帕功勳證。

scripts.text:
{0}
Then let's start.
scripts.translation:
{0}
那麼，我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
Ha ha ha. See, I told you. Oops, sorry. Forget that I just said that!!
scripts.translation:
{0}
哈哈哈哈哈。看吧，我早就告訴過你的。哎呀，抱歉。請忘掉我剛才說的話！！

scripts.text:
{0}
Greed is the reason for failing investments. Tsk, tsk.
scripts.translation:
{0}
貪婪是投資失敗的原因。嘖嘖。

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh no....!!!! What happened to the Golden Bell!
scripts.translation:
{0}
天哪....！！寵物鈴鐺怎麼了！

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm done. Hehe
scripts.translation:
{0}
完成了。嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
You haven't received a Sapha Certification yet?
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
您還沒有獲得沙帕功勳證嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Don't touch my back! I might bite you unconsciously.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
別摸我的背！我可能會在不知不覺中咬你。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Pub owner Shay carried something away to make something strange! Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
酒館老闆謝伊拿走了什麼東西去搞什麼奇怪的東西！小心點！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
We cats can jump 5 times our size. Isn't it cool? But then, don't ask me to jump from here now.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我們貓可以跳到自身體型5倍的高度。是不是很酷？不過，別讓我現在從這裡跳下去。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I have to be diligent with my grooming to maintain beautiful fur.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我必須勤快地舔毛，才能保持美麗的毛髮。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I have to groom myself everyday to maintain shiny fluffy fur. But I don't have very nice fur in the first place. Very sad.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我必須每天梳理毛髮，才能保持光亮蓬鬆。但我原本的毛髮就不怎麼好。真傷心。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
You should receive a Sapha Certification with both paws as a sign of respect. No cat deserves a certification if they don't!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
你應該用雙爪接過沙帕功勳證，以示尊重。如果不這樣做，就不配擁有功勳證。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
I don't really talk that much! Ahat looks like... meow meow meooow... sorry.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我其實不太愛說話！阿哈特看起來像...喵喵喵嗚...抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meow~~~~~~~~~~

[Jahbong]
Yarn is a great way to calm a cat.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
毛線是安撫貓咪的好方法。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Come back to me once you have one. I'll give you something good in exchange.
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
拿到一個之後回來找我。我會給你一些好東西作為交換。

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Why are you here?
Jahbong will exchange ^8000801 Sapha Certification^000000 for ^8000801 item^000000!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
你來這裡做什麼？
賈邦可以用^8000801 1個沙帕功勳證^000000交換^8000801 1個物品^000000！

scripts.text: Just came to see what you have.
scripts.translation: 只是來看看你有什麼。

scripts.text: I want the Feral Boots!
scripts.translation: 我要狂野長靴！

scripts.text: Give me the Feral Tail!
scripts.translation: 給我狂野尾巴！

scripts.text: Give me the Golden Bell!
scripts.translation: 給我寵物鈴鐺！

scripts.text: How much to buy you?
scripts.translation: 買你多少錢？

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
喵！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Feral Boots^000000 are shoes for your feet! Buy one and Jalapeno over there will refine it for you!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
^8000801狂野長靴^000000是穿在腳上的鞋子！買一雙，那邊的哈拉佩諾可以幫你精煉！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Feral Tail^000000 is pretty rough! Mancho over there can help you fix it!!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
^8000801狂野尾巴^000000有點粗糙！那邊的曼喬可以幫你修理！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
^8000801Golden Bell^000000 is an accessory. Brare spent 40 years making this! Or maybe 4 years! Oh well, come back when you need anything!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
^8000801寵物鈴鐺^000000是飾品。布拉爾花了40年製作這個！或者可能是4年！總之，有需要隨時回來！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
There are some crazy adventurers asking if they can purchase me! Jahbong is not for sale! I'll just bite you if you ask!!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
有些瘋狂的冒險者問能不能買我！賈邦不是用來賣的！如果你再問，我就咬你！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Meooooooooooow!!!!!!!!~~ Meooooooooow!!!!!
- ^800080Jahbong goes wild^000000. -

[Jahbong]
I'm not an item!! I will not be merciful if you treat me like one!!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
我不是物品！！如果你把我當物品對待，我絕不會心軟的！！

scripts.text: - He may react extremely, but Jahbong doesn't seem to be really angry. -
scripts.translation: - 他的反應很激烈，但賈邦似乎並沒有真的生氣。-

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Are you really buying something?!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
你真的要買點什麼嗎？！

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text: Give me!!!
scripts.translation: 給我！！！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Okay!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
好吧！

scripts.text:
[Jahbong]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[賈邦]
給你！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Hey, human! Did you come to make a request, too? When will it be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
嘿，人類！你也是來提交委託的嗎？什麼時候才輪到我啊？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Our Cat Paw Merchant group really needs any help it can get. But by the looks of all those requests that Ebenor is holding in his hand, Cat Paw Merchant will be closed by the time my request is put up on the board!
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
我們貓爪商團真的很需要任何幫助。但看埃貝諾爾手裡拿著的那些委託，等我的委託掛到公告板上時，貓爪商團都要關門了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
It breaks my heart to think my colleagues will be shivering in the blizzard. I hope I don't get into trouble since I can't do anything about it, right?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
想到我的同事們在暴風雪中瑟瑟發抖，我的心都碎了。希望我不會因為無能為力而惹上麻煩，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Hey, human! Did you come to make a request, too? When will it be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
嘿，人類！你也是來提交委託的嗎？什麼時候才輪到我啊？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Our Cat Paw Merchant group really needs any help it can get. But by the looks of all those requests that Ebenor is holding in his hand, Cat Paw Merchant will be closed by the time my request is put up on the board!
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
我們貓爪商團真的很需要任何幫助。但看埃貝諾爾手裡拿著的那些委託，等我的委託掛到公告板上時，貓爪商團都要關門了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
It breaks my heart to think my colleagues will be shivering in the blizzard. I hope I don't get into trouble since I can't do anything about it, right?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
想到我的同事們在暴風雪中瑟瑟發抖，我的心都碎了。希望我不會因為無能為力而惹上麻煩，對吧？

scripts.text: Why don't you collect it yourself?
scripts.translation: 你自己去收集吧

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 聽到這個我很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Human!! You're a genius!!
How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
人類！！你真是個天才！！
你是怎麼想到這個主意的？

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
I'm Agent Geck from the Cat Paw Merchant.
Car Paw Merchant has been wandering for a long time in this Midgard world ever since we lost our homeland.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
我是貓爪商團的特工蓋克。
自從失去家園以來，貓爪商團一直在米德加爾特這個世界流浪了很久。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But now we realize there is no place for our group here in Midgard.
Geck, Gyareuk and Gorureung did a lot of thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
但現在我們意識到，在米德加爾特沒有我們商團的位置。
蓋克、吉亞魯克和戈魯倫為此思考了很久。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But we finally found a place to settle!
It may be a bit cold but there are no Kafra or Jonda there!
We will gain ground in our new land!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
但我們終於找到了安身之地！
那裡可能有點冷，但沒有卡普拉或瓊達！
我們將在新的土地上站穩腳跟！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But of course, we don't have any influence over there to start with.
However, we plan to spare no efforts on it.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
但當然，我們在那裡起初沒有任何影響力。
不過，我們計劃不遺餘力地去開拓。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Human!! Did you know there is a huge hole near the Morocc village and nearby area?
They say you can travel to a new area through the hole!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
人類！！你知道莫洛村附近有一個巨大的洞嗎？
據說可以通過那個洞前往一個新的區域！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But you will have to go through tests and research to get to a place before trying it out.
To me, I think its all nonsense to go through the trouble!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
但你需要通過測試和研究才能到達那裡，然後再嘗試過去。
對我來說，我覺得費這麼大勁去折騰完全是胡扯！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
We must send someone as soon as possible to start exploring the area.
While the humans are frittering away, our Cat Paw Merchant should settle first and continue with our research.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
我們必須儘快派人去探索那個區域。
當人類還在虛度光陰時，我們貓爪商團應該先安頓下來並繼續我們的研究。

scripts.text: I also want to go and help the merchants.
scripts.translation: 我也想去幫助商人們

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
You are better than other humans!
If you really mean it, then sign here.
I'm collecting signs to get on Gyareuk's good side... never mind. I will let them know you are my sponsor!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
你比其他人類強多了！
如果你是真的這麼想的，那就在這裡簽字吧。
我正在收集簽名以討好吉亞魯克...算了。我會讓他們知道你是我的贊助人！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
{0}? Human names are strange to me.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
{0}？人類的名字對我來說很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now you are Geck's personal slav... sponsor.
Don't ask why you aren't Merchant sponsor.
A good human does not poke around where they are not supposed to.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
現在你是蓋克的私人奴...贊助人。
別問為什麼你不是商團的贊助人。
一個好人不會去窺探不該窺探的地方。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now since you've signed, all we need to do is leave for the other world.
I heard humans call it Ash-Vacuum.
Nobody explained to Geck why it was called that.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
既然你已經簽了字，我們只需要前往另一個世界。
我聽說人類稱之為“艾什真空”。
沒有人向蓋克解釋過為什麼叫這個名字。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
But human.
You will need to pay to get to the Ash-Vacuum.
There wouldn't be any expense for Geck to send you there myself but we must ask for help from other agents.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
但是人類。
你需要付費才能到達艾什真空。
蓋克親自送你過去不需要任何費用，但我們必須請求其他特工的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
So you will need some money to buy fish for agents who help you.
I will introduce you to an agent who will send you to the other world with no questions asked for only 50,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
所以你需要一些錢來買魚給那些幫助你的特工。
我會介紹一位特工給你，他只要50,000 Zeny就會不問緣由地送你到另一個世界。

scripts.text: Pay 50,000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 支付50,000 Zeny

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 絕對不行！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Geck learned not to deal with people who can't pay.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
蓋克學會了不與付不起錢的人打交道。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
With this, our contract is now complete.
Geck will help you to get to Ash-Vacuum in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
至此，我們的契約已經完成。
蓋克會幫你完好無損地抵達艾什真空。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Don't forget, human. The reason why Geck is helping you is to help the Cat Paw Merchant working hard in the other world.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
別忘了，人類。蓋克幫助你，是為了幫助在另一個世界辛勤工作的貓爪商人。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Now, I will transport you. Go meet our agent in the right corner.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
現在，我要傳送你了。去見見右下角的那位特工吧。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Geck doesn't force humans.
But I think you will change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
蓋克不會強迫人類。
但我認為你會改變主意的。

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
你見到艾什真空的貓爪商人了嗎，人類？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
But our Cat Paw Merchant will overcome any obstacle!
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
但我們的貓爪商人會克服任何障礙！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
你見到艾什真空的貓爪商人了嗎，人類？

scripts.text: Send me back
scripts.translation: 送我回去

scripts.text: I'm busy
scripts.translation: 我很忙

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
There is no time to waste, human!
I'll send you back right away!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
沒有時間浪費了，人類！
我馬上送你回去！

scripts.text:
[Agent Geck]
Hey, human! Didn't you say you will help the Cat Paw Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[特工 蓋克]
嘿，人類！你不是說要幫助貓爪商人嗎！

scripts.text:
[Cat]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[貓]
喵~

scripts.text:
A small Cat Paw Agent looks at you and nods its head towards the back.
Looks like it wants you to step up on its back to climb over the wall.
scripts.translation:
一隻小小的貓爪特工看著你，並朝後方點了點頭。
看來它想讓你踩在它的背上翻過牆去。

scripts.text: But you are so cute...
scripts.translation: 可是你好可愛...

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text: The small Cat Paw Agent has small black patterns as if it were stamped on it's white fur.
scripts.translation: 這隻小小的貓爪特工身上有黑色的花紋，像是印在它白色的毛髮上一樣。

scripts.text: The small body isn't as tall as your ankle and its small but thick paws look like little cushions. The ears that bent backwards when it looked at how big you were stirred up your protective instinct.
scripts.translation: 它小小的身體甚至不到你的腳踝高，那小而厚實的爪子看起來像小墊子。當它抬頭看你有多高大時，向後耷拉的耳朵激發了你的保護欲。

scripts.text: You don't seem to have the nerve to step on the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation: 你似乎沒有勇氣踩在貓爪特工身上。

scripts.text: You look at the Cat Paw Agent's small back and climb over the wall as quick as possible so that it wouldn't notice your weight.
scripts.translation: 你看著貓爪特工小小的背影，儘可能快地翻過牆去，以免它察覺到你的重量。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
This place as no meaning for us.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
這個地方對我們沒有意義。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Agent]
Heard from Geck.
I'm the Cat Paw Merchant's rising star, Tat.
scripts.translation:
[貓爪特工]
聽蓋克說。
我是貓爪商人的新星，塔特。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
I heard you are offering high-quality fish to pay for our passage.
I also heard the fish is very fresh and has shiny golden scales.
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
我聽說你願意提供高品質的魚來支付我們的通行費。
我還聽說那些魚非常新鮮，而且有著閃閃發光的金色鱗片。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
I usually only allow our Cat Paw Merchant agents to go through but since you are here on Geck's behalf and seeing you are reliable, I'll let you through.
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
通常我只允許貓爪商人的特工通過，但既然你是代表蓋克來的，而且看起來也很可靠，我就放你過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: To the other world!
scripts.translation: 前往另一個世界

scripts.text: I need some time.
scripts.translation: 我還需要一點時間

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Don't forget you are in debt to the Cat Paw Merchant, human!
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
別忘了，人類，你欠著貓爪商人的債呢！

scripts.text:
[Tat]
Aren't you suppose to be done getting ready before you come here?
scripts.translation:
[塔特]
難道你不應該在準備好之前再來這裡嗎？
